items.title_en: After-Hours Taiwan Stock Market on Aug 6: Revenue Leaders UMC, Unimicron, and ADATA Keep the Index Above Moving Averages; AI Stocks Surge, Memory and Cooling Sectors Lead
paras: 昨日 (8/6) 台股呈現高檔震盪與中小型股輪動格局。加權指數受台積電與聯發科高檔調節影響，小跌 214.90 點 (-0.48%)，收在 44,396.70 點，成交金額 9,694.70 億元，依然穩穩高於月線與季線，展現 TSE 站穩均線守季線氣勢；櫃買指數(OTC) 表現格外強勁，逆勢大漲 7.62 點(+1.99%)，收在 391.37 點，成交 2,233.51 億元，離季線雖還有段距離但反彈多頭動能充沛。籌碼面上，三大法人全市場合計買超 89.03 億元，其中外資全市場買超 54.06 億元，集中市場外資買超 20.20 億元、投信買超 88.56 億元、自營商賣超 63.13 億元；櫃買市場三大法人買超 40.72 億元。盤面上 AI 概念股全面噴發，記憶體與散熱表現最亮眼，金融金控與航空則相對回檔。
一、盤勢分析
台股加權指數受權值股調節微幅拉回 214.90 點收 44,396.70 點，然指數仍穩於月線與季線之上，均線多頭架構完好，TSE 站穩均線守季線意圖明確；櫃買市場 (OTC) 中小型股表現極佳，勁揚 1.99% 收 391.37 點，展現強烈收復行情。全市場三大法人合計買超 89.03 億元，外資與投信法人聯手加碼卡位中小型優質科技股。
二、強勢產業
・記憶體與利基型 IC(產能轉移價揚)：

受惠國際三大原廠將產能全面轉向 HBM 與高階 DDR5，造成傳統 DRAM 與 NAND Flash 嚴重產能排擠，加上 Edge AI 裝置與工控備貨旺季急單大爆發，合約價與現貨價強勢上揚。指標股群聯 (8299-TW) 亮燈漲停收 2,025.00 元，威剛 (3260-TW) 大漲 +6.31% 收 421.00 元，旺宏 (2337-TW) 亮燈漲停收 129.00 元；利基型 IC 晶豪科 (3006) 大飆 +7.95% 收 258.00 元，鈺創 (5351-TW) 漲 +6.74% 收 103.00 元，愛普 *(6531-TW)大漲 +5.26% 收 900.00 元。
・銅箔基板 (CCL)(AI 伺服器耗用倍增)：

全球 AI 伺服器與高效能運算 (HPC) 大舉採用高層數、大面積板材設計，驅動高階 Ultra Low-DK 銅箔基板消耗量倍增，龍頭廠產品單價與毛利率顯著拉升。聯茂 (6213-TW) 爆量亮燈漲停收 375.00 元，台燿 (6274-TW) 大漲 +4.08% 收 1,530.00 元，台光電 (2383-TW) 持穩高檔收 5,305.00 元，騰輝電子 - KY(6672-TW)上漲 +4.97% 收 232.50 元。
・散熱模組與 AI 伺服器 (水冷散熱量產)：
新一代高功耗 AI 晶片全面導入水冷散熱解決方案，冷卻水箱、CDU 主機與水冷板出貨量爆炸性成長，高階導軌需求同步加溫。雙鴻 (3324) 與建準 (2421-TW) 雙雙攻封漲停，奇鋐 (3017-TW) 大飆 +7.69% 收 2,940.00 元，川湖 (2059-TW) 暴漲 +6.65% 突破萬元關卡收 10,100.00 元。
三、弱勢產業
・金控與金融證券 (資金排擠拉回)：

加權指數高檔換手，盤面資金極端向中小型 AI 科技股集中，金融與證券板塊遭受資金排擠，法人逢高調節避險部位。富邦金 (2881-TW) 下跌 -2.70% 收 126.00 元，國泰金 (2882-TW) 下修 -2.99% 收 97.50 元，兆豐金 (2886) 下跌 -1.76% 收 50.30 元；群益證 (6005) 微跌 -0.86% 收 34.55 元，統一證 (2855-TW) 下修 -1.64% 收 45.10 元，福邦證 (6026-TW) 下跌 -1.77% 收 13.85 元。
・航空客運 (旺季利多反映)：
暑期旅遊旺季利多已於前期股價充分反映，市場焦點轉向第四季貨運趨勢，資金轉向高彈性電子股。長榮航 (2618-TW) 微跌 -1.26% 收 43.25 元，華航 (2610-TW) 下跌 -1.99% 收 22.15 元，星宇航空 (2646-TW) 微跌 -0.70% 收 21.30 元。

paras_en: Yesterday (Aug 6) the Taiwan market showed high‑level oscillation and a rotation among small‑ and mid‑cap stocks. The weighted index, affected by high‑level adjustments in TSMC and MediaTek, slipped 214.90 points (-0.48%) to close at 44,396.70, with a turnover of NT$969.47 billion, still firmly above the monthly and quarterly moving averages, demonstrating the TSE’s intent to stay above the averages and guard the quarterly line. The OTC (OTC) index performed especially strong, rallying against the trend by 7.62 points (+1.99%) to 391.37 with a turnover of NT$223.35 billion; although still a distance from the quarterly line, the rebound momentum is robust. On the capital‑flow side, the three major institutional investors net‑bought NT$8.903 billion across the whole market, with foreign investors buying NT$5.406 billion overall (NT$2.020 billion in the main board), investment trusts buying NT$8.856 billion, and dealers selling NT$6.313 billion; in the OTC market the three institutions net‑bought NT$4.072 billion. AI‑related stocks exploded across the board, with memory and cooling stocks shining the brightest, while financial holdings and airlines retreated.
1. Market Overview

The Taiwan weighted index was pulled back modestly by a correction in its heavyweight constituents, falling 214.90 points to 44,396.70, yet it remains above both the monthly and quarterly moving averages, preserving a clean bullish moving‑average structure and confirming the TSE’s clear intent to stay above the averages and protect the quarterly line. In the OTC market, small‑ and mid‑cap stocks performed exceptionally, jumping 1.99% to close at 391.37 and showing a strong recovery trend. Across the whole market, the three major institutional investors net‑bought NT$8.903 billion, with foreign investors and investment trusts jointly increasing their positions in quality mid‑cap technology stocks.
2. Strong Sectors
• Memory and niche‑type ICs (capacity shift driving price gains):

Benefiting from the three major global memory makers shifting all capacity to HBM and high‑end DDR5, traditional DRAM and NAND Flash have been severely squeezed. At the same time, edge‑AI devices and industrial‑control inventory seasons have sparked a surge in urgent orders, pushing contract and spot prices sharply higher. Leading stocks include UMC (8299‑TW) which hit the limit‑up and closed at NT$2,025.00, ADATA (3260‑TW) up 6.31% to NT$421.00, and Macronix (2337‑TW) which also hit the limit‑up at NT$129.00. Niche ICs saw similar strength: ChipMOS (3006) surged 7.95% to NT$258.00, Yuchuang (5351‑TW) rose 6.74% to NT$103.00, and Apacer (6531‑TW) jumped 5.26% to NT$900.00.
• Copper‑clad laminates (CCL) (AI server consumption multiplied):

Global AI servers and high‑performance computing (HPC) systems are increasingly using high‑layer, large‑area board designs, driving a multiple‑fold increase in demand for premium ultra‑low‑DK copper‑clad laminates. Leading manufacturers have seen product prices and gross margins rise sharply. Lianmao (6213‑TW) exploded in volume, hit the limit‑up and closed at NT$375.00; Tai Yao (6274‑TW) rose 4.08% to NT$1,530.00; Tai Optoelectronics (2383‑TW) held firm at a high level, closing at NT$5,305.00; and Tenghui Electronics – KY (6672‑TW) climbed 4.97% to NT$232.50.
• Cooling modules and AI servers (mass‑production water‑cooling):

The new generation of high‑power AI chips is being equipped with water‑cooling solutions across the board, causing explosive growth in shipments of cooling tanks, CDU units and water‑cooling plates, while demand for high‑end guide rails is also heating up. Double Hong (3324) and Jianzhun (2421‑TW) both hit the limit‑up, Qi Hong (3017‑TW) surged 7.69% to NT$2,940.00, and Chuanhu (2059‑TW) rocketed 6.65% past the NT$10,000 mark to close at NT$10,100.00.
3. Weak Sectors
• Financial holdings and securities (funds displaced, pull‑back):

The weighted index’s high‑level turnover concentrated capital into small‑ and mid‑cap AI tech stocks, squeezing out funds from the financial and securities sectors, where institutions trimmed positions as a hedge. Fubon Financial (2881‑TW) fell 2.70% to NT$126.00, Cathay Financial (2882‑TW) slipped 2.99% to NT$97.50, and Mega Financial (2886) dropped 1.76% to NT$50.30; Qunyi Securities (6005) edged down 0.86% to NT$34.55, Uni-President Securities (2855‑TW) fell 1.64% to NT$45.10, and Fubon Securities (6026‑TW) declined 1.77% to NT$13.85.
• Airline passenger transport (seasonal boost already priced in):

The summer travel‑season tailwinds have already been largely reflected in stock prices, shifting market focus to fourth‑quarter cargo trends and moving capital toward highly flexible electronics stocks. EVA Air (2618‑TW) slipped 1.26% to NT$43.25, China Airlines (2610‑TW) fell 1.99% to NT$22.15, and Starlux Airlines (2646‑TW) edged down 0.70% to NT$21.30.

items.title: 護盤急 宏普明起在每股29.25元以下再進場買回庫藏股1.6萬張
items.title_en: Hung Pu Ming Yi to Buy Back 16,000 Treasury Shares at NT$29.25 or Below per Share
paras: 上市建商宏普建設 (2536-TW) 上市掛牌已超過 30 年，繼上月 22 日提前執行完畢買回 6000 張庫藏股後，公司今 (6) 日決議自明 (7) 日起 2 個月內再進場買回 1.6 萬張庫藏股，如全數買齊，將占公司股權比重 4.81%，將用於註銷股本。
宏普明天起兩個月內在每股 29.25 元以下再執行買回庫藏股 1.6 萬張。這是是宏普上市 30 年來第二次執行買回庫藏股，用途在維護公司信用及股東權益。
宏普 2026 年上半年財報營收 49.91 億元，稅後純益 7.32 億元，每股純益達 2.2 元。而宏普至第一季底每股淨值達 38.91 元。
老牌建商宏普在今天的收盤價報 17.95 元
宏普在 7 月 22 日完成買回庫藏股 6000 張，庫藏股已占公司股權比例 1.8%。
宏普今年內湖舊宗段商辦大樓完工，總銷額 40.8 億元，未來完工時程包括 2027 年北投陽明案總銷 45 億元、2028 年時晴苑總銷 35 億元，以及 2029 年宏普中央公園三期總銷 60 億元。宏普手上土地庫存充沛，可供未來 4 年推案需求。
paras_en: Hung Pu Construction (2536-TW), a listed construction company, has been listed for over 30 years. After completing the buyback of 6,000 treasury shares on July 22, the company has decided to buy back an additional 16,000 treasury shares from tomorrow for a period of two months.

Starting from tomorrow, Hung Pu will buy back 16,000 treasury shares at NT$29.25 or below per share over the next two months. This is the company's second share buyback in its 30-year listing history, aimed at maintaining its credit and protecting shareholders' interests.

In the first half of 2026, Hung Pu's revenue was NT$4.991 billion, with a net profit of NT$732 million and earnings per share of NT$2.2. As of the end of the first quarter, the company's net asset value per share was NT$38.91.
The stock price of Hung Pu closed at NT$17.95 today.
On July 22, Hung Pu completed the buyback of 6,000 treasury shares, which now account for 1.8% of the company's total shares.

Hung Pu is expected to complete several projects in the coming years, including a commercial building in Neihu, with total sales of NT$4.08 billion, as well as the Yangming project in Beitou in 2027, with total sales of NT$4.5 billion, the Shi Qing Yuan project in 2028, with total sales of NT$3.5 billion, and the Hung Pu Central Park Phase 3 project in 2029, with total sales of NT$6 billion. The company has a sufficient land bank to meet its development needs for the next four years.

items.title: 緯創股利罕見二度延後發放！集保進場查缺失 金管會：最重將收回自辦股務
items.title_en: Wistron Delays Dividend Distribution Twice, Regulators Step In; Financial Supervisory Commission Says Worst Case Is Revoking Self-Managed Share Services
paras: 代工大廠緯創 (3231-TW) 近期因近 175 億元現金股利二度延後發放，引發市場關注與股東不滿。金管會今 (6) 日於例行記者會表示，緯創每股 5.5 元的現金股利已於今日全數發放完畢，針對延遲發放產生的利息補償金將另行補貼給受影響股東。證期局已要求集保結算所深入了解，若調查發現緯創在股務處理流程中有嚴重疏失，最重將「收回其自辦股務資格」，且未來不得再申請回歸自辦。

緯創原訂於 7 月 31 日發放現金股利，卻在 7 月 30 日晚間突發重訊宣布延至 8 月 3 日；不料 7 月 31 日晚間再度發布重訊，二度將發放日順延至 8 月 6 日。緯創聲明指出，延遲主因股務配合廠商三商電 (2427-TW) 的電腦作業系統有所疏失，導致資料錯誤；然而，三商電隨即於 8 月 3 日發布重訊強烈反擊，澄清其系統產製之檔案完整無誤，是緯創內部股務人員未全數採用最新檔案，致使匯款資料出現重複及缺漏，絕非系統作業疏失，雙方各執一詞。
對此，證期局副局長黃仲豪表示，緯創已於 8 月 5 日發布重訊承諾，針對延遲發放的天數將計算利息補償金給受影響股東。經主管機關確認，緯創今日已將原宣布的 5.5 元股利全數撥付完畢，後續利息補償則會個別通知並另行發放。
外界關注緯創與配合廠商間的責任歸屬，黃仲豪指出，依據證交所營業細則規定，上市櫃公司股利發放基準日與發放日之間不得超過三個月，實務上大多落在一個月左右。緯創此次雖未違反三個月的法定上限，但因「系統因素或資料疏失」而二度延後發放，在過去幾年中相當罕見。
外界質疑是否因公司財務出狀況才延發？黃仲豪澄清，依其重訊說明屬資料核對與系統釐清問題，而非財務危機。不過，即便公司聲稱為合作廠商責任，緯創身為發行公司，仍負有將股利完整、及時且正確撥付給股東的最終責任。證期局已請集保進一步調查，查明是否涉及資料不實、通知錯誤或不符合股務處理規定的缺失。
黃仲豪強調，若最終確定公司作業確實有不周全或嚴重疏失，主管機關除要求限期改善外，最重將收回其自辦股務的資格。
證期局官員補充說明，現行法規規定新上市櫃公司原則上皆須將股務委外辦理，目前僅早期留存的極少數公司具備自辦資格，全台僅有 10 家單一公司及 14 個集團 (涵蓋約 40、50 家公司) 屬於自辦股務，緯創即屬集團自辦之一。最近一次遭收回股務自辦之上市櫃公司為 2020 年的大同。
官員強調，股務代辦機構屬於高度監理的行業，具備較高的中立性與專業標準。若緯創因本次缺失遭到主管機關收回自辦股務資格，未來將強制轉為委外辦理，且「不能再回歸自辦」，除了經營成本增加外，對公司商譽與內部管理也是一大警訊。
paras_en: Wistron Corp (3231‑TW), a major contract manufacturer, recently postponed the distribution of a NT$175 billion cash dividend for the second time, drawing market attention and shareholder dissatisfaction. The Financial Supervisory Commission said at its regular press conference today (the 6th) that the NT$5.5 per share cash dividend has now been fully paid, and interest compensation for the delay will be paid separately to affected shareholders. The Securities and Futures Bureau has asked the Central Depository & Clearing Co. to investigate, warning that if serious lapses in Wistron's share‑administration processes are found, the worst penalty will be the revocation of its self‑managed share‑service qualification, with no future reinstatement allowed.

Wistron originally scheduled the cash dividend for July 31, but on the evening of July 30 it abruptly announced a postponement to August 3. Then, on the evening of July 31, it issued another notice pushing the payment date to August 6. Wistron blamed the delay on a computer‑system error by its share‑administration vendor, SANSUNG ELECTRONICS (2427‑TW), which allegedly caused data errors. SANSUNG ELECTRONICS countered on August 3, stating its system‑generated files were correct and that Wistron’s internal staff failed to use the latest files, resulting in duplicate and missing remittance data, not a system fault. Both parties maintain their own version of events.

In response, Securities and Futures Bureau Deputy Director Huang Chung‑hao said Wistron issued a notice on August 5 promising to calculate interest compensation for the delayed days and pay affected shareholders. The regulator confirmed that Wistron has today completed the full disbursement of the announced NT$5.5 dividend, and the interest compensation will be notified and paid individually.

Observers are focusing on the allocation of responsibility between Wistron and its vendor. Huang noted that under Taiwan Stock Exchange rules, the interval between the record date and the payment date for listed companies must not exceed three months, and in practice it is usually about one month. Although Wistron did not breach the three‑month statutory limit, a double postponement due to “system or data errors” is quite rare in recent years.

Some have questioned whether the delay signals financial distress. Huang clarified that the announcement attributes the issue to data verification and system clarification, not a financial crisis. Nevertheless, even if the company attributes fault to its vendor, Wistron, as the issuer, remains ultimately responsible for delivering dividends to shareholders accurately, timely and in full. The bureau has asked the Central Depository to further investigate possible data falsification, erroneous notifications or other violations of share‑administration regulations.

Huang emphasized that if it is ultimately confirmed that the company’s operations were inadequate or seriously negligent, regulators will not only require corrective measures within a set timeframe but may also revoke its self‑managed share‑service qualification as the most severe sanction.

Officials added that current regulations generally require newly listed companies to outsource share‑administration, with only a handful of early‑stage firms retaining self‑management rights – about ten individual companies and fourteen groups (covering roughly 40‑50 firms) nationwide. Wistron belongs to one of the group‑self‑managed entities. The most recent case of a listed company losing its self‑managed status was in 2020, when Tatung was stripped of the privilege.

The officials stressed that share‑administration agencies are a highly regulated sector, expected to maintain strong neutrality and professional standards. If Wistron loses its self‑managed qualification due to this lapse, it will be forced to outsource the function permanently, incurring higher operating costs and sending a strong warning signal to its corporate reputation and internal governance.

paras_en: Acer (2353-TW) announced its second-quarter earnings today, with a net profit of NT$21.7 billion, a 209.3% increase from the previous quarter and a 100.2% increase from the same period last year. EPS was 0.72. Acer attributed its success to its multi-business engine strategy, which has continued to ferment, resulting in a record-high net profit for a single quarter since the pandemic, with overall profitability shining brightly.

Acer's second-quarter revenue was NT$853 billion, a 17.8% increase from the previous quarter and a 28.2% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin was 11.4%, a 0.2 percentage point increase from the previous quarter and a 1.3 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Operating income was NT$17.8 billion, a 122% increase from the previous quarter and a 142.9% increase from the same period last year. paras: 一、盤勢重點與技術結構
指數走勢

技術面觀察

• 上檔 45K～46K 仍為套牢壓力區，需時間消化。

• 中小型股維持相對強勢，資金轉向題材股輪動。


二、影響盤勢的關鍵因素
國際總經變數
• 美伊衝突升溫，牽動能源供應鏈與油價波動。

• 通膨疑慮再起，使全球央行政策不確定性提高。
科技股財報干擾
• SpaceX 與 AMD 財報未達市場高預期，引發股價修正。

• 市場對 AI 成長短線預期修正，影響資金動能。
籌碼與資金面
• 外資出現「認錯回補」，轉為偏多操作。
• 半導體族群經歷去槓桿化，籌碼逐步沉澱。

• 國家隊、投信、ETF 與資金回流形成下檔支撐。


三、後市展望與策略判斷
指數節奏
• 預期 8 月台股將呈現「V 轉反彈＋區間震盪」格局。
• 指數區間落在 42K～46K 之間橫向整理。

• 透過時間換取空間，進行籌碼沉澱與底部築構。
中期展望
• 隨利空逐步鈍化與出盡，市場信心將回穩。
• 美國期中選舉與年底作夢行情有望接棒。

• 預期 9 月起至 Q4，有機會再啟一波創高行情。


四、產業與族群重點
AI 與半導體主軸
• AI 基礎建設仍處擴張初期，長線趨勢未變。
• CSP 資本支出持續增加，短期 FCF 壓力屬正常現象。

• 晶圓代工（台積電 (2330-TW)、聯電 (2303-TW)）、封測日月光 (3711-TW)、ASIC（創意 (3443-TW)、世芯 (3661-TW)、聯發科 (2454-TW)）持續受惠。
AI 供應鏈擴散
• 需求擴及 ASIC、先進封裝、記憶體、網通設備與電力基礎建設。

• 高速傳輸與算力需求推升整體半導體價值鏈。
光通訊與政策受惠
• 美國擬限制中國光通訊設備，帶動轉單效應。
• 台灣光通訊廠受惠 800G 與 1.6T 高速模組需求成長。

• 聯亞強勢表現，帶動族群成為市場焦點。
其他關注族群
• AI 伺服器、PCB/CCL、ABF 載板
• CPO 矽光子、記憶體、被動元件

• 先進封測設備、低軌衛星、機器人概念股


五、操作策略建議
選股邏輯
• 聚焦「AI 成長性＋產業趨勢＋籌碼優勢」個股。

• 避開僅題材炒作、基本面不足標的。
操作原則
• 採取「低接不追高」策略，避免情緒性進場。

• 區間震盪中重視節奏與資金控管。
風險控管
• 嚴守資金配置與停損紀律。

• 留意國際政經變數與市場情緒波動。


總結：
當前台股處於震盪築底階段，短線受消息面干擾，但中長期在 AI 產業趨勢、資金回流與基本面支撐下，結構仍偏多。操作上應以選股為核心，在震盪中布局具成長性的主流族群，為後續 Q4 行情預作準備。

items.title: 9400億量縮藏玄機！獨家數據曝賣壓轉折，兩大霸主營收創高「這時機」發動？
paras: 台股量縮震盪，是多頭熄火還是強勢洗盤？獨家買賣盤數據顯示賣壓已開始減輕，嘎空力道仍在醞釀，隨著散熱與 ASIC 雙霸主營收同創歷史新高，規格升級與專案放量確立產業優勢，鎖定關鍵轉折期，正是迎接下一波段行情的關鍵時機。
〈量縮震盪反映追價謹慎　籌碼仍在進行換手〉

台股今日成交金額約 9404 億元，接近月均量水準，加權指數終場下跌 214 點，收在 44396 點，跌幅 0.48%，這次量縮與前幾日部分個股觸及漲停限制、成交受到壓縮的結構不同，主要是指數推升至高檔後，市場追價意願轉趨謹慎，台積電 (2330-TW) 尾盤遭遇賣壓，聯發科 (2454-TW) 同步走弱，拖累大盤收黑，但鴻海 (2317-TW) 逆勢上漲，櫃買更收在 391 點、上漲 1.99%，顯示盤面並不是全面轉弱，而是資金進行高低位階調整。
櫃買指數目前月線仍然下彎，390 點附近又是前波頭部頸線壓力，短線拉回震盪屬於強勢反彈後的正常籌碼交換，智霖老師獨家數據顯示，今天買盤較前一日增加，賣盤則開始下降，雖然賣壓仍高於月平均，但壓力已經逐步減輕，強勢股家數也開始回升，目前美股仍在高檔整理，美債利率雖有回落，但幅度還不明顯，油價則開始趨緩，現階段應維持適當持股部位，觀察換手買盤能否延續。
〈散熱族群展現連動氣勢　營收成長支撐市場信心〉

今天盤面最強主軸仍是 AI 散熱族群，雙鴻 (3324-TW)7 月營收達 37.65 億元，月增 38.54%、年增 116.7%，創下歷史單月新高，帶動股價攻上漲停並重返千金股，反映水冷散熱進入出貨旺季，AI 伺服器規格升級也同步推升產品平均單價，帶動奇鋐(3017-TW)、建準(2421-TW)、鴻準(2354-TW) 與富世達 (6805-TW) 同步轉強，出現明確的族群連動，這才是市場資金認同產業方向的訊號，因為 AI 伺服器功耗持續提高，水冷散熱滲透率增加，產業結構仍在向上成長，奇鋐 (3017-TW) 後續營運同樣值得期待，但操作上仍要等待量價結構穩定。

items.title_en: Uni-President Q2 Profit Hits 34-Quarter High, H1 Net Profit Rises 36.37%
paras: 食品業龍頭統一企業 (1216-TW) 今 (6) 日公布最新財報獲利資訊，統一 2026 年第二季稅後純益 80.01 億元，創 34 季以來新高，季增 22.33%，年增 45.22%，單每股純益 1.41 元，2026 年 1-6 月統一稅後純益爲 145.5 億元，年增 36.37%，每股純益達 2.65 元。
統一 2026 年第二季營收 1749.21 億元，毛利率 33.98%，季增 0.2 個百分點，年增 0.18 個百分點，第二季單季稅後純益 80.01 億元，季增 22.33%，年增 45.22%，單每股純益 1.41 元。
統一 2026 年 1-6 月營收 3499.38 億元，毛利率 33.88%，年增 0.4 個百分點，後純益爲 145.5 億元，年增 36.37%，上半年每股純益達 2.65 元。
統一上半年主要轉投資收益包括 ，統一中控營收創新高，淨利人民幣 14.02 億元，同為同期歷史高點，年成長 9.0%，面對外部市場環境變化，公司憑藉多元產品組合與供應鏈彈性，展現營運韌性，持續鞏固穩健成長的基石，致本期淨利成長。
統一超商 (2912-TW) 上半年淨利 62.7 億元，年成長 5.5%，主要係台灣 7-ELEVEN 及轉投資事業包含菲律賓 7-ELEVEN、統一生活 (康是美)、悠旅生活 (星巴克) 等事業穩健，致本期淨利成長。
統一實業 (9907-TW) 上半年淨利 5.5 億元，較去年同期衰退 54.2%，主要係是鐵產品銷量降低及飲料客戶訂單微幅衰退所致，導致 2026 年上半年淨利衰退。

items.title: 〈遠傳法說〉成長引擎同步啟動 上半年EPS 2.14元創歷史新高
items.title_en: Far EasTone's Growth Engine Synchronized, First Half EPS Reaches Historic High of NT$2.14
paras: 遠傳 (4904-TW) 今 (6) 日召開法說會，受惠用戶穩定升級 5G、手機銷售與個人數位服務穩健成長，以及智慧資通訊動能延續，帶動今年上半年稅後純益 77.18 億元，每股純益 2.14 元，創歷史新高紀錄。
遠傳第二季營收 286.64 億元，季增 3.09%，年增 13.63%，創歷史同期高；EBITDA 101.55 億元，季增 0.78%，年增 8.12%，創單季新高；稅後純益 40.09 億元，季增 8.09%，年增 18.82%，同樣創單季新高，每股純益 1.11 元。
遠傳累計今年前 6 月營收 564.68 億元，年增 10.1%；EBITDA 232.31 億元，年增 7.2%；稅後純益 77.18 億元，年增 16.7%，每股純益 2.14 元。遠傳今年上半年營收、EBITDA、稅後純益皆為歷史新高紀錄，並全面超越財測目標，其中，稅後純益與 EPS 達成率達 113%。
受惠用戶持續升級 5G，加上攜碼需求動能強勁，帶動第二季行動服務營收達 158 億元，年增 3%；月租型用戶 ARPU 穩定向上，上半年月租型用戶 5G 滲透率提升至 49.3%。另外，數位娛樂營收年增 29%、阻詐服務營收年增 56%、行動金融服務營收年增 8%，也是推升上半年營運的動能。
針對個人數位服務業務，遠傳指出，「去哪吃」一站式餐飲平台自 4 月上線以來，已吸引超過 20 萬帳戶，預計年底可達到百萬用戶；與國際遊戲行銷平台 adjoe 合作推出「遊戲賺幣」服務，上線 2 個月即達成全年目標。創新資費方案獲用戶青睞，「5G 家用寬頻－居家娛樂包」銷售達成率超過 123%；瞄準 Gen Z 客群推出的「青春同行 588」方案，年輕族群占新申辦用戶比例達 33%。
娛樂事業上，遠傳 friDay 影音第二季付費用戶年增 20%，營收年增 17%。此外，「遠傳守護網」付費用戶數年增 44%。
企業智慧資通訊也持續成長，上半年智慧資通訊營收年增 23%。遠傳指出，在企業資通訊的四大領域中，永續智慧城市持續斬獲智慧路燈、能源系統等重要專案，其中智慧校園解決方案營收年增 46%。
數位轉型業務在 AI 與雲端需求推動下，上半年營收年增 50%，合約金額已超越 2025 全年度水準；智慧醫療專案陸續交付，遠距醫療合約金額年增 76%，智慧醫院解決方案年增 114%；電信系統整合領域，更取得多項智慧運輸與智慧基礎建設大型專案。
paras_en: Far EasTone (4904-TW) held a conference call today, benefiting from stable upgrades to 5G, smartphone sales, and digital services, as well as the continued momentum of intelligent communication, driving net profit of NT$7.718 billion in the first half, with EPS of NT$2.14, a historic high.

Far EasTone's second-quarter revenue reached NT$28.664 billion, up 3.09% from the previous quarter and 13.63% from the same period last year, a historic high. EBITDA was NT$10.155 billion, up 0.78% from the previous quarter and 8.12% from the same period last year, a new high for a single quarter. Net profit was NT$4.009 billion, up 8.09% from the previous quarter and 18.82% from the same period last year, also a new high for a single quarter, with EPS of NT$1.11.

Far EasTone's cumulative revenue for the first six months of the year reached NT$56.468 billion, up 10.1% from the same period last year. EBITDA was NT$23.231 billion, up 7.2% from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$7.718 billion, up 16.7% from the same period last year, with EPS of NT$2.14. Far EasTone's revenue, EBITDA, and net profit for the first half all set historic highs and exceeded the company's financial targets, with net profit and EPS achieving a 113% target rate.

Benefiting from continued upgrades to 5G and strong demand for bundled services, Far EasTone's second-quarter mobile service revenue reached NT$15.8 billion, up 3% from the same period last year. Monthly subscription-type users' ARPU remained stable, with a 49.3% 5G penetration rate for monthly subscription-type users in the first half. Additionally, digital entertainment revenue grew 29%, anti-fraud service revenue grew 56%, and mobile financial service revenue grew 8%, driving the company's operating momentum.

Regarding its personal digital services business, Far EasTone noted that its 'Where to Eat' one-stop dining platform, launched in April, has attracted over 200,000 accounts and is expected to reach one million users by the end of the year. In collaboration with international gaming marketing platform adjoe, the company launched the 'Game Earnings' service, which achieved its annual target in just two months. Innovative pricing plans have been well-received by users, with the '5G Home Broadband - Home Entertainment Package' sales rate exceeding 123%. The 'Youth Companion 588' plan, targeting Gen Z customers, accounted for 33% of new subscribers.

In the entertainment sector, Far EasTone's friDay Audio & Video service saw a 20% year-over-year increase in paid subscribers and a 17% year-over-year increase in revenue. Additionally, the company's 'Far EasTone Guardian Network' paid subscribers grew 44% year-over-year.

The company's enterprise intelligent communication business continued to grow, with a 23% year-over-year increase in revenue for the first half. Far EasTone noted that in the four major areas of enterprise communication, sustainable intelligent cities have secured significant projects, including intelligent streetlights and energy systems, with intelligent school solutions revenue growing 46%.

The company's digital transformation business grew 50% in the first half, driven by AI and cloud demand, with contract values exceeding the 2025 annual target. Intelligent medical projects have been delivered, with remote medical contracts growing 76% and intelligent hospital solutions growing 114%. In the area of telecommunications system integration, the company secured multiple large-scale intelligent transportation and intelligent infrastructure projects.

paras_en: Yesterday (Aug 6) the Taiwan market showed high‑level oscillation and a rotation among small‑ and mid‑cap stocks. The weighted index, affected by high‑level adjustments in TSMC and MediaTek, slipped 214.90 points (-0.48%) to close at 44,396.70, with a turnover of NT$969.47 billion, still firmly above the monthly and quarterly moving averages, demonstrating the TSE’s intent to stay above the averages and guard the quarterly line. The OTC (OTC) index performed especially strong, rallying against the trend by 7.62 points (+1.99%) to 391.37 with a turnover of NT$223.35 billion; although still a distance from the quarterly line, the rebound momentum is robust. On the capital‑flow side, the three major institutional investors net‑bought NT$8.903 billion across the whole market, with foreign investors buying NT$5.406 billion overall (NT$2.020 billion in the main board), investment trusts buying NT$8.856 billion, and dealers selling NT$6.313 billion; in the OTC market the three institutions net‑bought NT$4.072 billion. AI‑related stocks exploded across the board, with memory and cooling stocks shining the brightest, while financial holdings and airlines retreated.
1. Market Overview

The Taiwan weighted index was pulled back modestly by a correction in its heavyweight constituents, falling 214.90 points to 44,396.70, yet it remains above both the monthly and quarterly moving averages, preserving a clean bullish moving‑average structure and confirming the TSE’s clear intent to stay above the averages and protect the quarterly line. In the OTC market, small‑ and mid‑cap stocks performed exceptionally, jumping 1.99% to close at 391.37 and showing a strong recovery trend. Across the whole market, the three major institutional investors net‑bought NT$8.903 billion, with foreign investors and investment trusts jointly increasing their positions in quality mid‑cap technology stocks.
2. Strong Sectors
• Memory and niche‑type ICs (capacity shift driving price gains):

Benefiting from the three major global memory makers shifting all capacity to HBM and high‑end DDR5, traditional DRAM and NAND Flash have been severely squeezed. At the same time, edge‑AI devices and industrial‑control inventory seasons have sparked a surge in urgent orders, pushing contract and spot prices sharply higher. Leading stocks include UMC (8299‑TW) which hit the limit‑up and closed at NT$2,025.00, ADATA (3260‑TW) up 6.31% to NT$421.00, and Macronix (2337‑TW) which also hit the limit‑up at NT$129.00. Niche ICs saw similar strength: ChipMOS (3006) surged 7.95% to NT$258.00, Yuchuang (5351‑TW) rose 6.74% to NT$103.00, and Apacer (6531‑TW) jumped 5.26% to NT$900.00.
• Copper‑clad laminates (CCL) (AI server consumption multiplied):

Global AI servers and high‑performance computing (HPC) systems are increasingly using high‑layer, large‑area board designs, driving a multiple‑fold increase in demand for premium ultra‑low‑DK copper‑clad laminates. Leading manufacturers have seen product prices and gross margins rise sharply. Lianmao (6213‑TW) exploded in volume, hit the limit‑up and closed at NT$375.00; Tai Yao (6274‑TW) rose 4.08% to NT$1,530.00; Tai Optoelectronics (2383‑TW) held firm at a high level, closing at NT$5,305.00; and Tenghui Electronics – KY (6672‑TW) climbed 4.97% to NT$232.50.
• Cooling modules and AI servers (mass‑production water‑cooling):

The new generation of high‑power AI chips is being equipped with water‑cooling solutions across the board, causing explosive growth in shipments of cooling tanks, CDU units and water‑cooling plates, while demand for high‑end guide rails is also heating up. Double Hong (3324) and Jianzhun (2421‑TW) both hit the limit‑up, Qi Hong (3017‑TW) surged 7.69% to NT$2,940.00, and Chuanhu (2059‑TW) rocketed 6.65% past the NT$10,000 mark to close at NT$10,100.00.
3. Weak Sectors
• Financial holdings and securities (funds displaced, pull‑back):

The weighted index’s high‑level turnover concentrated capital into small‑ and mid‑cap AI tech stocks, squeezing out funds from the financial and securities sectors, where institutions trimmed positions as a hedge. Fubon Financial (2881‑TW) fell 2.70% to NT$126.00, Cathay Financial (2882‑TW) slipped 2.99% to NT$97.50, and Mega Financial (2886) dropped 1.76% to NT$50.30; Qunyi Securities (6005) edged down 0.86% to NT$34.55, Uni-President Securities (2855‑TW) fell 1.64% to NT$45.10, and Fubon Securities (6026‑TW) declined 1.77% to NT$13.85.
• Airline passenger transport (seasonal boost already priced in):

The summer travel‑season tailwinds have already been largely reflected in stock prices, shifting market focus to fourth‑quarter cargo trends and moving capital toward highly flexible electronics stocks. EVA Air (2618‑TW) slipped 1.26% to NT$43.25, China Airlines (2610‑TW) fell 1.99% to NT$22.15, and Starlux Airlines (2646‑TW) edged down 0.70% to NT$21.30.

paras_en: Hung Pu Construction (2536-TW), a listed construction company, has been listed for over 30 years. After completing the buyback of 6,000 treasury shares on July 22, the company has decided to buy back an additional 16,000 treasury shares from tomorrow for a period of two months.

Starting from tomorrow, Hung Pu will buy back 16,000 treasury shares at NT$29.25 or below per share over the next two months. This is the company's second share buyback in its 30-year listing history, aimed at maintaining its credit and protecting shareholders' interests.

In the first half of 2026, Hung Pu's revenue was NT$4.991 billion, with a net profit of NT$732 million and earnings per share of NT$2.2. As of the end of the first quarter, the company's net asset value per share was NT$38.91.
The stock price of Hung Pu closed at NT$17.95 today.
On July 22, Hung Pu completed the buyback of 6,000 treasury shares, which now account for 1.8% of the company's total shares.

Hung Pu is expected to complete several projects in the coming years, including a commercial building in Neihu, with total sales of NT$4.08 billion, as well as the Yangming project in Beitou in 2027, with total sales of NT$4.5 billion, the Shi Qing Yuan project in 2028, with total sales of NT$3.5 billion, and the Hung Pu Central Park Phase 3 project in 2029, with total sales of NT$6 billion. The company has a sufficient land bank to meet its development needs for the next four years.

items.title: 緯創股利罕見二度延後發放！集保進場查缺失 金管會：最重將收回自辦股務
items.title_en: Wistron Delays Dividend Distribution Twice, Regulators Step In; Financial Supervisory Commission Says Worst Case Is Revoking Self-Managed Share Services
paras: 代工大廠緯創 (3231-TW) 近期因近 175 億元現金股利二度延後發放，引發市場關注與股東不滿。金管會今 (6) 日於例行記者會表示，緯創每股 5.5 元的現金股利已於今日全數發放完畢，針對延遲發放產生的利息補償金將另行補貼給受影響股東。證期局已要求集保結算所深入了解，若調查發現緯創在股務處理流程中有嚴重疏失，最重將「收回其自辦股務資格」，且未來不得再申請回歸自辦。

緯創原訂於 7 月 31 日發放現金股利，卻在 7 月 30 日晚間突發重訊宣布延至 8 月 3 日；不料 7 月 31 日晚間再度發布重訊，二度將發放日順延至 8 月 6 日。緯創聲明指出，延遲主因股務配合廠商三商電 (2427-TW) 的電腦作業系統有所疏失，導致資料錯誤；然而，三商電隨即於 8 月 3 日發布重訊強烈反擊，澄清其系統產製之檔案完整無誤，是緯創內部股務人員未全數採用最新檔案，致使匯款資料出現重複及缺漏，絕非系統作業疏失，雙方各執一詞。
對此，證期局副局長黃仲豪表示，緯創已於 8 月 5 日發布重訊承諾，針對延遲發放的天數將計算利息補償金給受影響股東。經主管機關確認，緯創今日已將原宣布的 5.5 元股利全數撥付完畢，後續利息補償則會個別通知並另行發放。
外界關注緯創與配合廠商間的責任歸屬，黃仲豪指出，依據證交所營業細則規定，上市櫃公司股利發放基準日與發放日之間不得超過三個月，實務上大多落在一個月左右。緯創此次雖未違反三個月的法定上限，但因「系統因素或資料疏失」而二度延後發放，在過去幾年中相當罕見。
外界質疑是否因公司財務出狀況才延發？黃仲豪澄清，依其重訊說明屬資料核對與系統釐清問題，而非財務危機。不過，即便公司聲稱為合作廠商責任，緯創身為發行公司，仍負有將股利完整、及時且正確撥付給股東的最終責任。證期局已請集保進一步調查，查明是否涉及資料不實、通知錯誤或不符合股務處理規定的缺失。
黃仲豪強調，若最終確定公司作業確實有不周全或嚴重疏失，主管機關除要求限期改善外，最重將收回其自辦股務的資格。
證期局官員補充說明，現行法規規定新上市櫃公司原則上皆須將股務委外辦理，目前僅早期留存的極少數公司具備自辦資格，全台僅有 10 家單一公司及 14 個集團 (涵蓋約 40、50 家公司) 屬於自辦股務，緯創即屬集團自辦之一。最近一次遭收回股務自辦之上市櫃公司為 2020 年的大同。
官員強調，股務代辦機構屬於高度監理的行業，具備較高的中立性與專業標準。若緯創因本次缺失遭到主管機關收回自辦股務資格，未來將強制轉為委外辦理，且「不能再回歸自辦」，除了經營成本增加外，對公司商譽與內部管理也是一大警訊。
paras_en: Wistron Corp (3231‑TW), a major contract manufacturer, recently postponed the distribution of a NT$175 billion cash dividend for the second time, drawing market attention and shareholder dissatisfaction. The Financial Supervisory Commission said at its regular press conference today (the 6th) that the NT$5.5 per share cash dividend has now been fully paid, and interest compensation for the delay will be paid separately to affected shareholders. The Securities and Futures Bureau has asked the Central Depository & Clearing Co. to investigate, warning that if serious lapses in Wistron's share‑administration processes are found, the worst penalty will be the revocation of its self‑managed share‑service qualification, with no future reinstatement allowed.

Wistron originally scheduled the cash dividend for July 31, but on the evening of July 30 it abruptly announced a postponement to August 3. Then, on the evening of July 31, it issued another notice pushing the payment date to August 6. Wistron blamed the delay on a computer‑system error by its share‑administration vendor, SANSUNG ELECTRONICS (2427‑TW), which allegedly caused data errors. SANSUNG ELECTRONICS countered on August 3, stating its system‑generated files were correct and that Wistron’s internal staff failed to use the latest files, resulting in duplicate and missing remittance data, not a system fault. Both parties maintain their own version of events.

In response, Securities and Futures Bureau Deputy Director Huang Chung‑hao said Wistron issued a notice on August 5 promising to calculate interest compensation for the delayed days and pay affected shareholders. The regulator confirmed that Wistron has today completed the full disbursement of the announced NT$5.5 dividend, and the interest compensation will be notified and paid individually.

Observers are focusing on the allocation of responsibility between Wistron and its vendor. Huang noted that under Taiwan Stock Exchange rules, the interval between the record date and the payment date for listed companies must not exceed three months, and in practice it is usually about one month. Although Wistron did not breach the three‑month statutory limit, a double postponement due to “system or data errors” is quite rare in recent years.

Some have questioned whether the delay signals financial distress. Huang clarified that the announcement attributes the issue to data verification and system clarification, not a financial crisis. Nevertheless, even if the company attributes fault to its vendor, Wistron, as the issuer, remains ultimately responsible for delivering dividends to shareholders accurately, timely and in full. The bureau has asked the Central Depository to further investigate possible data falsification, erroneous notifications or other violations of share‑administration regulations.

Huang emphasized that if it is ultimately confirmed that the company’s operations were inadequate or seriously negligent, regulators will not only require corrective measures within a set timeframe but may also revoke its self‑managed share‑service qualification as the most severe sanction.

Officials added that current regulations generally require newly listed companies to outsource share‑administration, with only a handful of early‑stage firms retaining self‑management rights – about ten individual companies and fourteen groups (covering roughly 40‑50 firms) nationwide. Wistron belongs to one of the group‑self‑managed entities. The most recent case of a listed company losing its self‑managed status was in 2020, when Tatung was stripped of the privilege.

The officials stressed that share‑administration agencies are a highly regulated sector, expected to maintain strong neutrality and professional standards. If Wistron loses its self‑managed qualification due to this lapse, it will be forced to outsource the function permanently, incurring higher operating costs and sending a strong warning signal to its corporate reputation and internal governance.

paras_en: Acer (2353-TW) announced its second-quarter earnings today, with a net profit of NT$21.7 billion, a 209.3% increase from the previous quarter and a 100.2% increase from the same period last year. EPS was 0.72. Acer attributed its success to its multi-business engine strategy, which has continued to ferment, resulting in a record-high net profit for a single quarter since the pandemic, with overall profitability shining brightly.

Acer's second-quarter revenue was NT$853 billion, a 17.8% increase from the previous quarter and a 28.2% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin was 11.4%, a 0.2 percentage point increase from the previous quarter and a 1.3 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Operating income was NT$17.8 billion, a 122% increase from the previous quarter and a 142.9% increase from the same period last year. Operating margin was 2.1%, a 1.0 percentage point increase from the previous quarter and a 1.0 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$21.7 billion, a 209.3% increase from the previous quarter and a 100.2% increase from the same period last year, with EPS at 0.72.

Acer's first-half revenue was NT$1,577.3 billion, a 23.3% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin was 11.3%, a 1.0 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Operating income was NT$25.9 billion, a 45.9% increase from the same period last year. Operating margin was 1.6%, a 0.2 percentage point increase from the same period last year. Net profit was NT$28.7 billion, a 79.6% increase from the same period last year, with EPS at 0.96.

items.title: 巴菲特罕見警告股市狂熱 歷史數據已預告接下來會發生什麼
items.title_en: Buffett Issues Rare Warning About Market Mania; Historical Data Predicts What’s Next
paras: 標普 500、那斯達克與道瓊指數近年屢創新高，投資人樂觀情緒推升市場持續走強。然而，過度的好事未必是福，漲多的標的終究會回檔修正。「股神」巴菲特近期也對當前投資環境發出警告，提醒市場參與者留意過度投機風險，而歷史經驗或許能為未來走勢提供重要參考。
投資人現在可能是在「賭博」
在波克夏 (BRK.A-US) 2026 年股東常會期間接受 CNBC 採訪時，巴菲特感嘆了當今金融市場中日益普遍的投機風氣。
他指出，自己經常把市場比作一間附設賭場的教堂，前者代表長期價值投資，後者則代表短期投機下注。
「賭場對人們變得非常有吸引力，」他強調，「那不是投資，不是投機，那是賭博。」不過他也補充說，「這並不代表投資本身很糟，但確實意味著非常多東西的價格看起來會荒謬至極。」
歷史預示著接下來會發生什麼
歷史顯示，巴菲特的這番斷言並非毫無根據。過去幾年間估值持續狂飆，多項股市指標暗示許多股票目前可能遭到高估。
巴菲特自己偏好的指標「巴菲特指標」（Buffet indicator），最近創下歷史新高。這項數據衡量美國股市總市值與 GDP 之間的關係，巴菲特本人曾指出，當該指標逼近 200% 時，投資人就是在「玩火」。該指標目前來到 232%。
標普 500 席勒本益比（Shiller CAPE Ratio）是另一項逼近風險區間的指標。它透過追蹤標普 500 指數經通膨調整後的 10 年期盈餘來衡量整體市場估值，目前也正逼近歷史高點。
自 5 月以來，該本益比一直持續徘徊在 40 以上，而歷史上唯一一次持續維持在該水準之上，是在網際網路泡沫爆破之前，當時它觸及略高於 44 的峰值。
投資人仍有好消息
目前無法確定未來數月或數年內，市場是否會重演類似網路泡沫時期的熊市，即使是巴菲特也無法準確預測市場走勢。不過，如果歷史能證明一件事，那就是具備良好基本面的投資，最終仍能穿越市場波動。
儘管目前許多股票可能估值偏高，但正如巴菲特所言，這並不代表投資時機已經消失。關鍵在於尋找價格合理且基本面穩健的企業，包括財務體質健康、管理團隊優秀，以及具備長期競爭力的商業模式。
在網路泡沫期間，數百檔科技股股價重挫，許多企業至今仍未恢復。然而，少數成功存活並成長的公司，最終成為全球最具價值的企業之一。自 2000 年至今，標普 500 指數累計總報酬率已超過 700%。
如果歷史給投資人一項建議，那就是持續布局高品質的長期投資標的。透過健全的投資組合，即使面對未來市場變化，仍有機會累積長期財富。
paras_en: The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow Jones have been hitting fresh highs in recent years, with investor optimism driving the market higher. Yet excessive good news isn’t always a blessing, and heavily rallied stocks eventually pull back for correction. “Oracle of Omaha” Warren Buffett has recently warned about the current investment environment, urging market participants to watch for over‑speculation risk, and history may offer important clues for future trends.
Investors may now be "gambling"
During Berkshire Hathaway’s (BRK.A-US) 2026 annual shareholder meeting, Buffett told CNBC that today’s financial markets are increasingly dominated by speculative behavior.
He likened the market to a church with an attached casino – the former representing long‑term value investing, the latter short‑term speculative betting.

"The casino becomes very attractive to people," he emphasized. "That’s not investing, it’s not speculation, it’s gambling." He added, "That doesn’t mean investing itself is bad, but it does mean many prices look absurdly high."
What History Predicts Next
History shows Buffett’s remarks are not unfounded. Valuations have surged in recent years, and several market metrics suggest many stocks may now be overvalued.

Buffett’s favored metric, the “Buffett Indicator,” has recently hit a historic high. This measure compares total U.S. market capitalization to GDP; Buffett has warned that when it approaches 200%, investors are “playing with fire.” It now stands at 232%.

The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE Ratio is another metric edging toward a risk zone. It tracks the inflation‑adjusted ten‑year earnings of the S&P 500 to gauge overall market valuation and is also nearing historic peaks.
Since May, the CAPE has lingered above 40, and the only time it stayed that high was before the dot‑com bubble burst, when it peaked just above 44.
Investors Still Have Good News

It remains uncertain whether the market will repeat a bear‑run like the dot‑com era in the coming months or years, and even Buffett cannot forecast the market precisely. However, history shows that investments with solid fundamentals eventually weather market turbulence.

Although many stocks appear overvalued now, as Buffett notes, this does not mean the opportunity to invest has vanished. The key is to find companies with reasonable prices and strong fundamentals, including healthy balance sheets, excellent management, and durable competitive business models.

During the dot‑com bubble, hundreds of tech stocks crashed and many have never recovered. Yet a few survivors grew to become some of the world’s most valuable companies. Since 2000, the S&P 500’s cumulative total return has exceeded 700%.

If history offers investors one piece of advice, it is to keep building a portfolio of high‑quality, long‑term holdings. With a sound investment mix, investors can still accumulate wealth over time despite future market changes.

items.title: 摩根大通：亞洲科技股回檔 不代表AI投資周期終結
items.title_en: JPMorgan: Asian Tech Stocks Pullback Doesn’t Signal End of AI Investment Cycle
paras: 近期亞洲科技股與費城半導體指數出現約 25% 至 30% 的顯著修正，引發市場對於人工智慧熱潮是否降溫的疑慮。然而，根據摩根大通最新發布的報告顯示，他們認為這類市場波動並不代表 AI 投資周期的結束，並指出產業基本面依然強勁。

產業基本面穩固

摩根大通分析指出，此次修正為 2022 年底 AI 驅動行情以來的第三次大規模回撤。分析師強調，目前幾乎沒有證據顯示 AI 產業基本面正在放緩，且預計未來 6 至 12 個月內不會出現顯著疲軟。
摩根大通預期，超大型雲端服務業者 (Hyperscalers) 不會輕易削減 AI 資本支出，甚至在 2027 年前都不會退出 AI 計算領域的投資，並可能透過股權或債券市場融資來支持基礎設施擴張。

設備與先進封裝領跑

在半導體產業鏈中，摩根大通最為看好半導體設備製造商，認為隨著晶圓廠設備 (WFE) 投資加速，該領域在未來 12 個月內最具優勢。此外，隨著 2.5D 封裝技術普及，以及台積電啟動 3D 封裝投資周期，封裝與測試產業將迎來強勁增長。零件方面，則以 IC 載板最被看好。
在記憶體市場，雖然基本面依然穩健，且預計未來兩到三年的供應增長將低於需求，但摩根大通提醒，受輝達 (NVDA-US) 與 AMD(AMD-US) 調整產品記憶體配置比例影響，記憶體股可能難以重回 5 月的高點。

潛在風險與未來限制

儘管對技術前景保持樂觀，摩根大通在另一份報告中提出警示，指出目前的 AI 動能與網路泡沫時期有相似之處，市場獲利過於集中於少數股票，且存在估值與基本面脫節的風險。他們建議投資者應適度轉向價值股並進行地理分散配置。
展望長期發展，摩根大通預計，電力供應可能在未來 18 至 24 個月取代晶片本身，成為 AI 基礎設施發展的主要瓶頸。同時，隨著運算效率變得至關重要，互連技術 (Interconnect) 也將成為下一個關鍵挑戰。
paras_en: Recent Asian technology stocks and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index have experienced a notable correction of about 25% to 30%, raising concerns that the AI hype may be cooling. However, JPMorgan’s latest report says this market volatility does not indicate the end of the AI investment cycle and notes that the industry fundamentals remain strong.

Industry fundamentals remain solid

JPMorgan analysis points out that this correction is the third large pullback since the AI‑driven rally at the end of 2022. Analysts stress that there is virtually no evidence that the AI sector’s fundamentals are slowing, and they expect no significant weakness over the next 6 to 12 months.

JPMorgan expects that hyperscale cloud providers will not readily cut AI capital spending and that they will stay invested in AI compute through at least 2027, possibly financing infrastructure expansion through equity or bond markets.

Equipment and advanced packaging lead the way

Within the semiconductor supply chain, JPMorgan is most bullish on semiconductor equipment makers, believing that accelerating wafer‑fab equipment (WFE) investment will give this segment the greatest advantage over the next 12 months. In addition, the spread of 2.5D packaging and TSMC’s launch of a 3D‑packaging investment cycle will drive strong growth in the packaging and testing sector, with IC substrates being the most favored component.

In the memory market, fundamentals remain solid and supply growth over the next two to three years is expected to lag demand. However, JPMorgan warns that memory stocks may struggle to retake May’s highs due to product memory‑mix adjustments by Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US).

Potential risks and future constraints

While maintaining an optimistic view of the technology outlook, JPMorgan’s other report flags that current AI momentum bears similarities to the dot‑com bubble, with profits overly concentrated in a few stocks and a risk of valuation‑fundamental disconnect. They advise investors to tilt toward value stocks and diversify geographically.

Looking ahead, JPMorgan projects that power supply could become the primary bottleneck for AI infrastructure development within the next 18 to 24 months, potentially overtaking the chip itself. As compute efficiency becomes critical, interconnect technology will also emerge as the next key challenge.

items.title: 減重藥燒錢企業也買單 美銀一年砸2.5億美元挺員工用GLP-1
items.title_en: US Bank Spends $250 Million a Year on Employee GLP-1 Weight Loss Medication
paras: 以應酬文化盛行著稱的銀行業，意外成為減肥藥 GLP-1 的重要買單者。美國銀行 (BAC-US) 執行長布萊恩 · 莫伊尼漢（Brian Moynihan）透露，該行目前每年為員工負擔高達 2.5 億美元的 GLP-1 減重藥物費用。儘管支出快速攀升，他仍認為這項投資「物有所值」。
莫伊尼漢在談及相關成本時表示，該行在 GLP-1 藥物上的支出大約為 2.5 億美元或更多，而在四、五年前這個數字還是零。
據悉，美國銀行每年為約 21.1 萬名員工的醫療支出預留超過 20 億美元，這意味著 GLP-1 藥物目前已經佔據這筆預算的 13% 左右。
這番表態恰逢全球兩大 GLP-1 藥物生產商更新業績之際，其中諾和諾德與禮來 (LLY-US) 皆公布了最新的市場預期，顯示出這類藥物在全球範圍內的強勁需求與龐大商業規模。
在藥廠獲利豐厚的同時，全美各地的雇主都在應對 GLP-1 藥物引發的成本激增壓力。
對美國市場而言，一名患者用藥一年的成本可能高達數千美元。許多採用自保醫療模式的大企業和政府雇主發現，隨著 GLP-1 減肥藥的使用量快速增長，醫療支出壓力明顯上升，因此紛紛開始限制報銷範圍，或者討論是否還能負擔這些昂貴的治療。
然而，美國銀行卻採取了截然不同的態度，認為這筆巨額支出相當值得。莫伊尼漢指出，美國銀行在提供這些藥物的同時，也配套提供健康指導服務，以幫助員工監測減重過程並調整生活方式。
除了長期的預防性健康管理之外，他還指出越來越多的臨床數據顯示，這類藥物可能帶來更短期的健康益處，包括降低心血管事件發生率。
他總結道，觀察員工在這些調整過程中的行為變化以及體重下降，是一件非常有趣的事情。
同時，這家全美第二大銀行也正在利用自身的規模優勢，積極與藥廠以及藥品福利管理機構展開談判，以爭取更低的藥品價格。
莫伊尼漢強調，他們正在向所有相關方施壓，努力把價格壓到盡可能低的水平，並堅信考慮到這些藥物帶來的長期健康收益以及可能帶來的短期健康改善，這是一項非常值得進行的投資。
paras_en: US Bank, known for its lavish corporate culture, has become a major buyer of the weight loss medication GLP-1. Bank CEO Brian Moynihan revealed that the bank currently spends up to $250 million a year on GLP-1 medication for its employees, despite the rapidly increasing cost.
Moynihan noted that the bank's spending on GLP-1 medication is approximately $250 million or more, up from zero just four or five years ago.
According to reports, US Bank allocates over $2 billion a year for its employees' medical expenses, which means GLP-1 medication currently accounts for around 13% of this budget.

This statement comes as the two major GLP-1 medication manufacturers, Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly, have recently updated their earnings, showing strong demand and a massive commercial scale for this type of medication globally.
While pharmaceutical companies are reaping huge profits, employers across the US are struggling to cope with the rising costs of GLP-1 medication.

For the US market, a patient's annual cost of using GLP-1 medication can be as high as several thousand dollars. Many large companies and government employers that have adopted self-insured medical plans have found that the rapid growth in GLP-1 medication usage has significantly increased their medical expenses, leading them to restrict coverage or discuss whether they can still afford these expensive treatments.

However, US Bank has taken a different approach, considering the massive expenditure worthwhile. Moynihan pointed out that the bank provides health guidance services alongside the medication to help employees monitor their weight loss progress and adjust their lifestyles.

In addition to long-term preventive health management, he noted that more and more clinical data show that these medications may bring short-term health benefits, including a reduced risk of cardiovascular events.
He concluded that observing employees' behavior changes and weight loss is a very interesting thing.
At the same time, the second-largest bank in the US is using its scale to actively negotiate with pharmaceutical companies and pharmacy benefit managers to secure lower prices for the medication.

Moynihan emphasized that they are putting pressure on all relevant parties to try to bring the price down as much as possible and believe that considering the long-term health benefits and possible short-term health improvements, this is a worthwhile investment.

items.title: SanDisk(SNDK-US)：2027年資料中心將占NAND市場一半 AI需求推升供不應求延續
items.title_en: SanDisk: AI Demand to Drive NAND Market to Half-Year Supply Shortage in 2027
paras: 2026年08月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心持續大量採購儲存設備，讓NAND Flash記憶體市場維持供不應求。SanDisk(SNDK-US)在最新法說會表示，目前客戶下單速度仍快於公司擴產速度，預期市場供給吃緊的情況將延續至2027年底之後，價格可望持續獲得支撐。
SanDisk指出，AI推論（Inference）快速普及，使資料中心需要安裝更多高容量SSD來儲存與讀取資料，每一次AI運算都會產生大量資料，帶動NAND Flash需求持續攀升。公司預估，2027年資料中心將占整體NAND市場約一半，成為最大的需求來源。
雖然AI需求持續成長，SanDisk並未採取大幅擴建晶圓廠的方式增加供給，而是調整產能擴張策略，將重點放在BiCS 8與BiCS 10等新製程轉換，透過提高單位晶圓可生產的儲存容量，讓bit供給維持中至高雙位數成長。例如，最新BiCS 10採用332層NAND架構，儲存密度超過29 Gb/mm²，較前一代提升59%。
儘管如此，管理層表示，目前需求成長仍快於供給，因此不少產品仍採取配貨（allocation）方式供應，也就是客戶即使想買更多，公司也沒有足夠產能立即供貨。
為了避免過去記憶體產業大起大落的景氣循環，SanDisk近幾季也改變銷售模式，不再只按季度接單，而是與大型AI資料中心客戶簽訂4至5年的長期供貨合約。目前已有8家大型客戶加入，2027財年超過50%的產能已提前售出，2028財年更有約三分之二產能已被預訂。
更值得注意的是，公司透露，部分客戶才剛簽完長約數個月，就再次增加未來3至5年的採購量，顯示AI基礎建設需求仍持續升溫，而非短期現象。
SanDisk執行長David Goeckeler表示，過去NAND市場多半每季重新議價，供需波動較大；如今公司已掌握超過4年的訂單能見度，能依據客戶長期需求安排投資與產能，有助於降低過去供過於求、價格暴跌的情況。
財報方面，SanDisk本季營收達98.65億美元，高於市場預估的83.95億美元；每股盈餘39.25美元，也優於市場預估的34.52美元。公司預估下一季營收將達103億至108億美元，高於市場預估的106.2億美元區間下緣。

paras_en: August 6, 2026 (Opt Analytics/Industry Data Center Report) - AI data centers continue to purchase storage equipment in large quantities, maintaining a shortage in the NAND Flash memory market. SanDisk (SNDK-US) stated in its latest earnings call that customer orders are still outpacing the company's production capacity, and the market supply shortage is expected to continue beyond the end of 2027, with prices likely to remain supported.

SanDisk pointed out that the rapid proliferation of AI inference has led to data centers needing to install more high-capacity SSDs to store and read data, with each AI computation generating a large amount of data, driving NAND Flash demand to continue rising. The company estimates that data centers will account for about half of the total NAND market in 2027, becoming the largest source of demand.

Although AI demand continues to grow, SanDisk has not taken a large-scale expansion of its wafer factory to increase supply, but rather adjusted its production capacity expansion strategy, focusing on new process conversions such as BiCS 8 and BiCS 10, through which the company aims to maintain high double-digit growth in bit supply by increasing the storage capacity of each wafer.
For example, the latest BiCS 10 uses a 332-layer NAND architecture, with a storage density of over 29 Gb/mm², a 59% increase over the previous generation.

Despite this, management stated that the current demand growth is still faster than supply, with many products being supplied through allocation, meaning that even if customers want to buy more, the company does not have enough production capacity to supply immediately.

To avoid the past memory industry's boom-and-bust cycle, SanDisk has changed its sales model in recent quarters, no longer only taking orders on a quarterly basis, but signing 4- to 5-year long-term supply contracts with large AI data center customers. Currently, 8 large customers have joined, with over 50% of production capacity already sold out for the 2027 fiscal year, and approximately two-thirds of production capacity already booked for the 2028 fiscal year.

Notably, the company revealed that some customers have increased their future purchases of 3- to 5-years within a few months of signing long-term contracts, indicating that AI infrastructure demand continues to heat up, rather than being a short-term phenomenon.

SanDisk CEO David Goeckeler stated that in the past, the NAND market was largely renegotiated every quarter, with supply and demand fluctuations being large; now, the company has visibility of over 4 years of orders, allowing it to arrange investments and production capacity based on long-term customer demand, which has helped to reduce the past over-supply and price crashes.

In terms of financials, SanDisk's quarterly revenue reached $9.865 billion, exceeding market estimates of $8.395 billion; earnings per share were $39.25, also exceeding market estimates of $34.52. The company estimates that next quarter's revenue will reach $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion, exceeding market estimates of $10.62 billion.
