items.title: 特斯拉與SpaceX正悄悄合併？AI成最大連結
items.title_en: Tesla and SpaceX: A Quiet Merger? AI as the Key Connection
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，特斯拉 (Tesla)(TSLA-US) 股價周三 (5 日) 下跌，與 SpaceX(SPACEX-US) 同步走弱。除了共同由馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 執掌外，這兩家公司之間的連結已不只是因為他。
特斯拉當日下跌 1.8%，收在 321.55 美元。SpaceX 周二盤後公布第二季財報後，周三股價下跌 13.6% 至 108.27 美元。
問題似乎並不在於財報數字。SpaceX 公布的營收與獲利均優於市場預期。該股在財報公布前的周一與周二累計上漲近 16%，經周三回跌後，這周股價下跌 0.1 美元。
特斯拉股價走勢呈相同模式。截至周三交易前，受惠於周一與周二漲勢，該股本周累計上漲約 5%。
特斯拉與 SpaceX 當然有許多共同點，除了執行長都是馬斯克之外，兩家公司都正大舉投資人人工智慧，並合作開發 AI 應用及一座半導體製造設施。
SpaceX 正投入數百億美元，盡可能快速建造 AI 資料中心。第二季 AI 資本支出達 158 億美元，高於去年同期的 7.49 億美元，AI 算力提升至 1.4GW，高於去年同期的 0.4GW。
特斯拉第二季在新廠房及設備上的資本支出為 58 億美元，高於 2025 年第二季的 24 億美元。公司表示，其 AI 算力在 2026 年上半年已增加超過一倍。
特斯拉利用這些算力訓練車輛自動駕駛等技術，SpaceX 則將算力出租給 Anthropic 與 Google，同時持續開發自家 Grok AI 模型。
正因雙方都將重心放在 AI，因此不少華爾街分析師認為，兩家公司最終合併幾乎不可避免。過去一周，馬斯克不得不出面平息市場猜測，否認特斯拉將出售其中國業務，以協助推動與 SpaceX 合併。
理論上，此舉將使合併程序更加順利，因為可排除中國批准交易等監管障礙，以及降低美國政府對身為國防承包商的 SpaceX 在中國擁有大量業務的疑慮。
這會是一項代價高昂的決定。特斯拉約 20% 年度銷售額來自中國。根據中國乘用車市場信息聯席會 (CPCA) 數據，特斯拉中國工廠 7 月共售出 93,579 輛汽車，較去年同期成長 38%。這項數據為批發銷量，包含出口。這也是特斯拉中國廠連續第 9 個月實現年增。
若未來真的推動合併，時間點可能仍在一年之後。因此，投資人目前仍可把更多注意力放在特斯拉本身的營運表現，例如其中國廠的生產情況。
在 SpaceX 財報電話會議上，特斯拉僅被提及一次。
馬斯克表示，「我會說，在中國以外，SpaceX 和特斯拉可能是全球硬體實力最強的兩家公司，即使把中國算進來，也可能是如此。」
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) shares fell on Wednesday (5th), in sync with SpaceX (SPACEX-US) weakness. Beyond their shared leadership by Elon Musk, the connection between the two companies goes beyond him.
Tesla fell 1.8% on the day, closing at $321.55. SpaceX's stock fell 13.6% to $108.27 on Wednesday, after announcing its second-quarter earnings on Tuesday.

The problem doesn't seem to be with the financial numbers. SpaceX's revenue and profit exceeded market expectations. The stock rose nearly 16% over the two days leading up to the earnings announcement, and then fell 0.1% on Wednesday.
Tesla's stock price followed a similar pattern. As of Wednesday's trading, the stock had risen about 5% for the week, thanks to the gains on Monday and Tuesday.

Tesla and SpaceX have many commonalities, aside from Musk's leadership. Both companies are heavily investing in artificial intelligence and collaborating on AI applications and a semiconductor manufacturing facility.

SpaceX is investing hundreds of billions of dollars to build AI data centers as quickly as possible. Its second-quarter AI capital expenditure was $15.8 billion, up from $7.49 billion in the same period last year, and its AI computing power rose to 1.4GW, up from 0.4GW last year.

Tesla's second-quarter capital expenditure on new factory buildings and equipment was $5.8 billion, up from $2.4 billion in the same period last year. The company said its AI computing power has increased by more than double in the first half of 2026.
Tesla is using this computing power to train autonomous driving technologies, while SpaceX is renting out its computing power to Anthropic and Google, and continuing to develop its own Grok AI model.

As both companies focus on AI, many Wall Street analysts believe that a merger between the two is almost inevitable. In the past week, Musk has had to deny speculation that Tesla would sell its Chinese business to facilitate a merger with SpaceX.

Theoretically, this would make the merger process smoother, as it would eliminate regulatory hurdles in China and reduce concerns about SpaceX's large business in China, which is a defense contractor.

However, this would be a costly decision. Tesla gets about 20% of its annual sales from China. According to data from the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA), Tesla's Chinese factory sold 93,579 vehicles in July, up 38% from the same period last year.
If a merger is pushed through in the future, it may still be a year away. Therefore, investors can focus more on Tesla's own operational performance, such as production at its Chinese factory.
During SpaceX's earnings conference call, Tesla was only mentioned once.
Musk said, 'I would say that, outside of China, SpaceX and Tesla may be the two strongest hardware companies in the world, even if you include China.'

items.title: 記憶體股血流成河 馬斯克一句話救信心：供不應求才剛開始
items.title_en: Memory Stocks Flooded with Blood, Musk’s One Sentence Restores Confidence: Supply Shortage Is Just Beginning
paras: 美國兩大記憶體廠商 SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 與威騰電子 (WDC-US) 雖公布亮眼財報，但業績展望未達市場高期待，引發投資人失望，兩家公司股價週三（5 日）美股盤後雙雙重挫。記憶體股賣壓隨後蔓延至亞洲，南韓「記憶體雙雄」SK 海力士 (000660KS) 與三星電子 (005930KS) 週四分別下跌 10.3% 及 6.3%，日本快閃記憶體大廠鎧俠股價也暴跌逾 10%，市場憂慮 AI 帶動的記憶體行情面臨獲利預期修正壓力。
然而，在 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 執行長馬斯克看來，投資者完全不應為記憶體的需求感到擔憂，因為在 AI 熱潮中，最大的瓶頸之一正是記憶體。他明確表示，記憶體晶片的需求增長速度遠遠超過了供應增速。
馬斯克對記憶體晶片的需求狀況具備很強的發言權，因為特斯拉和 SpaceX 均是記憶體晶片的重要買家。特斯拉和 SpaceX 的未來發展都高度依賴於人工智能，並且都在大舉斥資採購 AI 晶片、記憶體晶片以及其它用於數據中心的 AI 基礎設施，這意味著馬斯克擁有洞察記憶體需求的絕佳視角。
SpaceX 週三公佈了 IPO 後的首份業績，隨後的電話會議展示了關於火箭、機器人、星艦和衛星的宏大計劃。然而，對於緊盯半導體股票、每日跟隨晶片股行情變動的市場而言，真正抓住人們眼球的是馬斯克關於記憶體晶片的深刻言論。
「目前的限制因素是記憶體，」馬斯克直言，「記憶體產量每年增長約 20%。通常來說，這對任何龐大且成熟的行業而言，這一速度已經非常驚人。但請想一想：需求每年增長 20% 嗎？不，需求每年增長 200% 甚至更多。所以，當需求的增長速度遠超供給時，基礎經濟學原理告訴我們，價格應該上漲，而不是下跌。」
馬斯克的這一觀點，與一些分析師近期提出的理論形成了鮮明對比。
此前，部分分析師認為 SK 海力士等公司的產能擴張，可能會導致記憶體晶片供過於求並壓低價格。整個夏季，市場都在激烈爭論半導體超級週期能否延續，投資者對 AI 資本開支熱潮能持續多久充滿疑慮。
在 7 月遭受重創後，進入 8 月晶片類股行情雖有所回暖，但當前圍繞晶片類股的市場情緒仍然十分脆弱。由於 Sandisk 和威騰電子的業績，未能滿足投資者的超高期待，週四亞洲市場上的記憶體族群才出現了大幅下跌。
儘管 SanDisk 與威騰電子的營收和利潤均超出市場預期，但 Sandisk 的業績指引略微不及市場預期，而威騰電子的指引也未能帶來任何驚喜，相較於希捷科技上週給出的業績指引要遜色得多。
高盛指出，過高的市場預期令兩家公司的股價難以從亮眼業績中獲益，導致業績公佈後兩檔股票雙雙承壓下跌。馬斯克此次的公開表態，或許能為動盪不安的記憶體晶片市場注入一劑強心針。
paras_en: U.S. memory giants SanDisk (SNDKV-US) and Western Digital (WDC-US) posted impressive earnings, but their outlook fell short of lofty market expectations, disappointing investors and sending both stocks sharply lower after Wednesday’s (the 5th) U.S. market close. The sell‑off in memory stocks then spread to Asia, where South Korea’s “memory twins” SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) fell 10.3% and 6.3% respectively on Thursday, and Japanese flash‑memory leader Kioxia saw its shares plunge more than 10%, as the market worries that AI‑driven memory demand is now facing profit‑margin revisions.

However, SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk argues investors should not worry about memory demand at all, because one of the biggest bottlenecks in the AI boom is precisely memory. He stated clearly that the growth rate of demand for memory chips far outpaces the growth rate of supply.

Musk’s view on memory‑chip demand carries weight because both Tesla and SpaceX are major buyers of memory chips. Their future development is heavily dependent on artificial intelligence, and they are pouring money into AI chips, memory chips and other AI‑infrastructure for data centers, giving Musk an excellent perspective on memory demand.

SpaceX released its first post‑IPO earnings on Wednesday, and the subsequent earnings call highlighted ambitious plans for rockets, robots, Starship and satellites. Yet for a market that watches semiconductor stocks and chip‑stock movements daily, the real headline‑grabber was Musk’s pointed comments on memory chips.

“The current constraint is memory,” Musk said bluntly. “Memory production is growing about 20% a year. For any large, mature industry that’s already a remarkable rate. But think about this: does demand grow 20% a year? No – demand is growing 200% or more each year. So when demand outpaces supply that dramatically, basic economics tells us prices should rise, not fall.”
Musk’s viewpoint stands in stark contrast to theories recently put forward by some analysts.

Earlier, several analysts warned that capacity expansions by companies such as SK Hynix could lead to oversupply of memory chips and push prices down. Throughout the summer, the market has fiercely debated whether the semiconductor super‑cycle can continue, and investors remain skeptical about how long the AI‑capex frenzy will last.

After a heavy hit in July, the chip sector showed some recovery in August, but sentiment around chip stocks remains fragile. Because SanDisk’s and Western Digital’s results failed to meet investors’ sky‑high expectations, the memory segment in Asian markets slumped sharply on Thursday.

Although both SanDisk and Western Digital posted revenue and profit above market forecasts, SanDisk’s guidance fell slightly short of expectations and Western Digital’s outlook offered no surprises, lagging far behind the guidance Seagate gave last week.

Goldman Sachs noted that overly lofty market expectations made it hard for the two companies’ shares to benefit from their strong results, causing both stocks to slide after the announcements. Musk’s public remarks may provide a much‑needed boost to the turbulent memory‑chip market.

items.title: Situational Awareness基金斷臂求生後 已花4億美元重返投資市場
items.title_en: Situational Awareness Fund Re-enters Investment Market After Near Collapse
paras: 前 OpenAI 研究員、現年 25 歲的華爾街新晉投資者 Leopold Aschenbrenner，其執掌的避險基金 Situational Awareness 在經歷了瀕臨崩潰僅僅幾天之後，已經重返投資市場，對一家非上市公司押注 4 億美元。

在 7 月初，Situational Awareness 的資產規模曾高達 450 億美元，但隨著其持有的上市科技股價值迅速縮水，引發了華爾街貸款機構大規模追繳保證金。為了應對資金壓力，Aschenbrenner 一度考慮出售其引以為傲的私募股權，如 Anthropic、Fluidstack 與 MatX 等公司的股份。最終，他與 Ken Griffin 旗下的 Citadel 達成協議，出售了大部分的上市股票組合，以償還貸款並保住私募股權持倉。
這也讓他付出了極大的代價，截至上周四，這支基金的資產規模已暴跌至約 100 億美元，早先槓桿押注賺取的巨額收益，在保證金追繳令的追殺下已付之一炬。
儘管基金元氣大傷，但 Aschenbrenner 隨即展現了重返市場的決心。據知情人士透露，基金已於本周二向一家非上市公司投資 4 億美元，這是繼上個月投入 1 億美元後的追加投資。雖然目前尚不清楚這筆資金具體流向投資組合中的哪家公司，但此舉被視為他試圖透過長期價值投資來重建基金的初步信號。
Situational Awareness 的投資者結構特殊，大多為舊金山灣區的富裕人士與家族辦公室，包括 D1 Capital 創辦人 Dan Sundheim 等知名大咖。儘管經歷劇震，目前尚未出現大規模撤資跡象。
Aschenbrenner 在致投資者的信中承諾，他幾乎所有的個人資產都投入了這支基金，並將從此次經驗中吸取教訓，成為更強大的投資人。
值得一提的是，在基金動盪最劇烈的那個周六，Aschenbrenner 於加州卡梅爾谷完成婚禮，其妻子現任 Anthropic 執行長的幕僚長。這場被譽為「AI 皇室婚禮」的慶典與基金的生存保衛戰同時上演，戲劇性十足。目前他已取消蜜月，親自與每位擔憂的投資者進行電話溝通以安撫情緒。
paras_en: Leopold Aschenbrenner, a 25-year-old former OpenAI researcher and new investor on Wall Street, has led his hedge fund Situational Awareness back into the investment market after a near-collapse, betting $4 billion on a private company.

In early July, Situational Awareness had assets of $45 billion, but the value of its publicly traded tech stocks plummeted, triggering a massive margin call from Wall Street lenders. To address the funding pressure, Aschenbrenner considered selling his prized private equity stakes, including those in Anthropic, Fluidstack, and MatX. Ultimately, he reached an agreement with Ken Griffin's Citadel to sell most of his public stock portfolio to repay loans and preserve his private equity holdings.
This came at a great cost, as the fund's assets had plummeted to around $10 billion by last Thursday, with the huge profits from its earlier leveraged bets wiped out by the margin calls.

Despite the fund's severe losses, Aschenbrenner quickly demonstrated his determination to re-enter the market. According to insiders, the fund invested $4 billion in a private company on Tuesday, following an additional $1 billion investment last month. Although it is unclear which company received the funding, this move is seen as a sign of his attempt to rebuild the fund through long-term value investing.

Situational Awareness has a unique investor structure, primarily consisting of wealthy individuals and family offices from the San Francisco Bay Area, including D1 Capital founder Dan Sundheim. Despite the turmoil, there are no signs of massive withdrawals yet.
In a letter to investors, Aschenbrenner pledged that nearly all of his personal assets are invested in the fund and that he will learn from this experience to become a stronger investor.

Notably, during the most turbulent week for the fund, Aschenbrenner got married in California's Carmel Valley, with his wife serving as the chief of staff to the CEO of Anthropic. This 'AI royal wedding' took place simultaneously with the fund's survival battle, making for a dramatic scene. Aschenbrenner has now canceled his honeymoon and is personally calling concerned investors to reassure them.

items.title: 上周按兵不動是觀察期！Fed庫克放鷹：通膨若不退準備支持升息
items.title_en: Last Week’s Hold Was an Observation Period! Fed’s Cook Takes a Hawkish Stance: Ready to Support Rate Hikes if Inflation Doesn’t Cool
paras: 美國聯準會 (Fed) 理事庫克 (Lisa Cook) 周三 (6 日) 表示，她認為上周沒有必要升息，但若通膨未能很快降溫，她已準備支持進一步升息。 ，以因應「仍然過高」的物價壓力。
庫克在阿拉斯加安克拉治經濟發展公司 (Anchorage Economic Development Corporation) 舉辦的 2026 年經濟午餐會發表演說，她說道：「如果通膨沒有很快開始降溫，我已準備好在必要時採取升息行動。」
她認為在 Fed 雙重使命中，目前通膨風險高於就業風險。若有必要升息抑制物價，她也會同時評估對整體經濟的影響。
她說：「如果有必要讓通膨回落，我將支持升息，但也有可能最後不需要。」

抗通膨空間正在縮小

庫克表示，由於美國通膨已連續五年高於 Fed 設定的 2% 目標，通膨預期逐漸根深蒂固的風險正持續升高。根據 Fed 偏好的個人消費支出 (PCE) 物價指數，6 月通膨年增率為 3.7%。
庫克警告，通膨可能逐漸反映在企業定價與薪資形成過程中，使 Fed 日後壓低通膨的難度提高。她說：「通膨高於目標的時間愈長，這種情況發生的可能性就愈高。因此，在目前環境下，我們沒有等待更久的餘裕。」

上周支持利率不變的原因

庫克並解釋，她上周支持維持利率不變，主因是目前推升通膨的幾項因素未必會持續。去年開始實施的關稅大多已反映在物價上，由於比較基期墊高，未來對通膨的推升效果可能逐步減弱。
她也提到，中東衝突推升油價，但市場普遍預估油價年底前將回落。此外，目前因人工智慧 (AI) 需求帶動而飆升的相關零組件價格，未來也可望隨供應鏈調整而下降。
她說：「因此，我認為目前適合先按兵不動，觀察這些因素如何演變。」

內部鷹聲起

Fed 上周以九比三決議維持聯邦基金利率目標區間於 3.50-3.75% 不變，但已有三位地區聯準銀行總裁主張立即升息 1 碼，以抑制通膨，分別是哈瑪克 (Beth Hammack)、卡什卡里(Neel Kashkari) 和蘿根(Lorie Logan)。
相較之下，Fed 主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 仍未針對未來利率路徑提供明確指引，也未詳細說明其貨幣政策決策邏輯。
卡什卡利周三接受 CNBC 訪問時表示，為抑制通膨，現在應開始循序漸進升息，但並非主張大幅提高利率。
另一方面，堪薩斯城聯準銀行總裁施密德 (Jeff Schmid) 周二晚間表示，目前通膨仍過高，要讓通膨回落仍需更高利率支撐。
施密德說：「考量需求與投資依然強勁，我不認為目前貨幣政策立場具有抑制性。」他今年並非聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 具有投票權的成員。
paras_en: Fed Governor Lisa Cook said on Wednesday (the 6th) that she believes there was no need to raise rates last week, but if inflation does not cool quickly she is prepared to support further hikes to address "still too high" price pressures.

Cook made the remarks at a 2026 economic luncheon hosted by the Anchorage Economic Development Corporation, stating, "If inflation does not start to cool quickly, I am ready to take rate‑hiking action when necessary."
She said that within the Fed’s dual mandate, the inflation risk currently outweighs the employment risk, and if a hike is needed to curb prices she will also assess the impact on the broader economy.
She added, "If it is necessary to bring inflation down, I will support a rate hike, but it may ultimately not be needed."

The anti‑inflationary space is shrinking. Cook noted that U.S. inflation has been above the Fed’s 2% target for five consecutive years, and the risk of entrenched inflation expectations is rising. According to the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, June’s annual inflation rate was 3.7%.

Cook warned that inflation could gradually become embedded in corporate pricing and wage‑setting, making it harder for the Fed to bring it down later. She said, "The longer inflation stays above target, the more likely this scenario becomes. Therefore, we do not have the luxury of waiting any longer in the current environment."

Why she supported keeping rates steady last week. Cook explained that the main factors driving inflation may not persist. Most tariffs imposed since last year have already been reflected in prices, and because the base period was higher, their inflationary impact is likely to fade.

She also mentioned that Middle‑East conflicts have pushed oil prices up, but markets generally expect oil to retreat before year‑end. In addition, the surge in component prices driven by AI demand is expected to ease as supply chains adjust.
She said, "Therefore, I think it is appropriate now to hold steady and observe how these factors evolve."

Internal hawks emerge. The Fed voted 9‑3 last week to keep the federal funds target range at 3.50‑3.75% but three regional bank presidents—Beth Hammack, Neel Kashkari and Lorie Logan—advocated an immediate one‑point hike to curb inflation.
In contrast, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has not provided clear guidance on the future rate path nor detailed the logic behind his monetary‑policy decisions.
Kashkari told CNBC on Wednesday that to curb inflation the Fed should now begin a gradual series of rate hikes, though he does not call for a large jump in rates.
Meanwhile, Jeff Schmid, president of the Kansas City Fed, said on Tuesday night that inflation remains too high and that bringing it down will require higher rates for support.
Schmid said, "Given that demand and investment remain strong, I do not think the current monetary stance is restrictive." He is not a voting member of the Federal Open Market Committee this year.

items.title: 巴菲特罕見警告股市狂熱 歷史數據已預告接下來會發生什麼
items.title_en: Buffett Issues Rare Warning About Market Mania; Historical Data Predicts What’s Next
paras: 標普 500、那斯達克與道瓊指數近年屢創新高，投資人樂觀情緒推升市場持續走強。然而，過度的好事未必是福，漲多的標的終究會回檔修正。「股神」巴菲特近期也對當前投資環境發出警告，提醒市場參與者留意過度投機風險，而歷史經驗或許能為未來走勢提供重要參考。
投資人現在可能是在「賭博」
在波克夏 (BRK.A-US) 2026 年股東常會期間接受 CNBC 採訪時，巴菲特感嘆了當今金融市場中日益普遍的投機風氣。
他指出，自己經常把市場比作一間附設賭場的教堂，前者代表長期價值投資，後者則代表短期投機下注。
「賭場對人們變得非常有吸引力，」他強調，「那不是投資，不是投機，那是賭博。」不過他也補充說，「這並不代表投資本身很糟，但確實意味著非常多東西的價格看起來會荒謬至極。」
歷史預示著接下來會發生什麼
歷史顯示，巴菲特的這番斷言並非毫無根據。過去幾年間估值持續狂飆，多項股市指標暗示許多股票目前可能遭到高估。
巴菲特自己偏好的指標「巴菲特指標」（Buffet indicator），最近創下歷史新高。這項數據衡量美國股市總市值與 GDP 之間的關係，巴菲特本人曾指出，當該指標逼近 200% 時，投資人就是在「玩火」。該指標目前來到 232%。
標普 500 席勒本益比（Shiller CAPE Ratio）是另一項逼近風險區間的指標。它透過追蹤標普 500 指數經通膨調整後的 10 年期盈餘來衡量整體市場估值，目前也正逼近歷史高點。
自 5 月以來，該本益比一直持續徘徊在 40 以上，而歷史上唯一一次持續維持在該水準之上，是在網際網路泡沫爆破之前，當時它觸及略高於 44 的峰值。
投資人仍有好消息
目前無法確定未來數月或數年內，市場是否會重演類似網路泡沫時期的熊市，即使是巴菲特也無法準確預測市場走勢。不過，如果歷史能證明一件事，那就是具備良好基本面的投資，最終仍能穿越市場波動。
儘管目前許多股票可能估值偏高，但正如巴菲特所言，這並不代表投資時機已經消失。關鍵在於尋找價格合理且基本面穩健的企業，包括財務體質健康、管理團隊優秀，以及具備長期競爭力的商業模式。
在網路泡沫期間，數百檔科技股股價重挫，許多企業至今仍未恢復。然而，少數成功存活並成長的公司，最終成為全球最具價值的企業之一。自 2000 年至今，標普 500 指數累計總報酬率已超過 700%。
如果歷史給投資人一項建議，那就是持續布局高品質的長期投資標的。透過健全的投資組合，即使面對未來市場變化，仍有機會累積長期財富。
paras_en: The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow Jones have been hitting fresh highs in recent years, with investor optimism driving the market higher. Yet excessive good news isn’t always a blessing, and heavily rallied stocks eventually pull back for correction. “Oracle of Omaha” Warren Buffett has recently warned about the current investment environment, urging market participants to watch for over‑speculation risk, and history may offer important clues for future trends.
Investors may now be "gambling"
During Berkshire Hathaway’s (BRK.A-US) 2026 annual shareholder meeting, Buffett told CNBC that today’s financial markets are increasingly dominated by speculative behavior.
He likened the market to a church with an attached casino – the former representing long‑term value investing, the latter short‑term speculative betting.

"The casino becomes very attractive to people," he emphasized. "That’s not investing, it’s not speculation, it’s gambling." He added, "That doesn’t mean investing itself is bad, but it does mean many prices look absurdly high."
What History Predicts Next
History shows Buffett’s remarks are not unfounded. Valuations have surged in recent years, and several market metrics suggest many stocks may now be overvalued.

Buffett’s favored metric, the “Buffett Indicator,” has recently hit a historic high. This measure compares total U.S. market capitalization to GDP; Buffett has warned that when it approaches 200%, investors are “playing with fire.” It now stands at 232%.

The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE Ratio is another metric edging toward a risk zone. It tracks the inflation‑adjusted ten‑year earnings of the S&P 500 to gauge overall market valuation and is also nearing historic peaks.
Since May, the CAPE has lingered above 40, and the only time it stayed that high was before the dot‑com bubble burst, when it peaked just above 44.
Investors Still Have Good News

It remains uncertain whether the market will repeat a bear‑run like the dot‑com era in the coming months or years, and even Buffett cannot forecast the market precisely. However, history shows that investments with solid fundamentals eventually weather market turbulence.

Although many stocks appear overvalued now, as Buffett notes, this does not mean the opportunity to invest has vanished. The key is to find companies with reasonable prices and strong fundamentals, including healthy balance sheets, excellent management, and durable competitive business models.

During the dot‑com bubble, hundreds of tech stocks crashed and many have never recovered. Yet a few survivors grew to become some of the world’s most valuable companies. Since 2000, the S&P 500’s cumulative total return has exceeded 700%.

If history offers investors one piece of advice, it is to keep building a portfolio of high‑quality, long‑term holdings. With a sound investment mix, investors can still accumulate wealth over time despite future market changes.

items.title: 摩根大通：亞洲科技股回檔 不代表AI投資周期終結
items.title_en: JPMorgan: Asian Tech Stocks Pullback Doesn’t Signal End of AI Investment Cycle
paras: 近期亞洲科技股與費城半導體指數出現約 25% 至 30% 的顯著修正，引發市場對於人工智慧熱潮是否降溫的疑慮。然而，根據摩根大通最新發布的報告顯示，他們認為這類市場波動並不代表 AI 投資周期的結束，並指出產業基本面依然強勁。

產業基本面穩固

摩根大通分析指出，此次修正為 2022 年底 AI 驅動行情以來的第三次大規模回撤。分析師強調，目前幾乎沒有證據顯示 AI 產業基本面正在放緩，且預計未來 6 至 12 個月內不會出現顯著疲軟。
摩根大通預期，超大型雲端服務業者 (Hyperscalers) 不會輕易削減 AI 資本支出，甚至在 2027 年前都不會退出 AI 計算領域的投資，並可能透過股權或債券市場融資來支持基礎設施擴張。

設備與先進封裝領跑

在半導體產業鏈中，摩根大通最為看好半導體設備製造商，認為隨著晶圓廠設備 (WFE) 投資加速，該領域在未來 12 個月內最具優勢。此外，隨著 2.5D 封裝技術普及，以及台積電啟動 3D 封裝投資周期，封裝與測試產業將迎來強勁增長。零件方面，則以 IC 載板最被看好。
在記憶體市場，雖然基本面依然穩健，且預計未來兩到三年的供應增長將低於需求，但摩根大通提醒，受輝達 (NVDA-US) 與 AMD(AMD-US) 調整產品記憶體配置比例影響，記憶體股可能難以重回 5 月的高點。

潛在風險與未來限制

儘管對技術前景保持樂觀，摩根大通在另一份報告中提出警示，指出目前的 AI 動能與網路泡沫時期有相似之處，市場獲利過於集中於少數股票，且存在估值與基本面脫節的風險。他們建議投資者應適度轉向價值股並進行地理分散配置。
展望長期發展，摩根大通預計，電力供應可能在未來 18 至 24 個月取代晶片本身，成為 AI 基礎設施發展的主要瓶頸。同時，隨著運算效率變得至關重要，互連技術 (Interconnect) 也將成為下一個關鍵挑戰。
paras_en: Recent Asian technology stocks and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index have experienced a notable correction of about 25% to 30%, raising concerns that the AI hype may be cooling. However, JPMorgan’s latest report says this market volatility does not indicate the end of the AI investment cycle and notes that the industry fundamentals remain strong.

Industry fundamentals remain solid

JPMorgan analysis points out that this correction is the third large pullback since the AI‑driven rally at the end of 2022. Analysts stress that there is virtually no evidence that the AI sector’s fundamentals are slowing, and they expect no significant weakness over the next 6 to 12 months.

JPMorgan expects that hyperscale cloud providers will not readily cut AI capital spending and that they will stay invested in AI compute through at least 2027, possibly financing infrastructure expansion through equity or bond markets.

Equipment and advanced packaging lead the way

Within the semiconductor supply chain, JPMorgan is most bullish on semiconductor equipment makers, believing that accelerating wafer‑fab equipment (WFE) investment will give this segment the greatest advantage over the next 12 months. In addition, the spread of 2.5D packaging and TSMC’s launch of a 3D‑packaging investment cycle will drive strong growth in the packaging and testing sector, with IC substrates being the most favored component.

In the memory market, fundamentals remain solid and supply growth over the next two to three years is expected to lag demand. However, JPMorgan warns that memory stocks may struggle to retake May’s highs due to product memory‑mix adjustments by Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US).

Potential risks and future constraints

While maintaining an optimistic view of the technology outlook, JPMorgan’s other report flags that current AI momentum bears similarities to the dot‑com bubble, with profits overly concentrated in a few stocks and a risk of valuation‑fundamental disconnect. They advise investors to tilt toward value stocks and diversify geographically.

Looking ahead, JPMorgan projects that power supply could become the primary bottleneck for AI infrastructure development within the next 18 to 24 months, potentially overtaking the chip itself. As compute efficiency becomes critical, interconnect technology will also emerge as the next key challenge.

items.title: 記憶體「三國」掀變局：三星市佔重返39%登頂 美光緊咬SK海力士
items.title_en: Memory "Three Kingdoms" Shift: Samsung Reclaims 39% Market Share, Micron Noses Ahead of SK Hynix
paras: Counterpoint Research 最新《全球儲存追蹤》報告指出，全球 DRAM 市場格局正加速洗牌。三星電子 (005930KS) 第二季市佔率持續攀升，重回 2024 年以來高點；SK 海力士 (000660KS) 則因市占率下滑，與快速追趕的美光科技 (MU-US) 形成激烈競爭。此外，中國 DRAM 廠長鑫科技 (688825-CN) 高速成長，正為全球記憶體產業帶來新的變數。
報告數據指出，三星電子在今年第二季成功拿下全球 DRAM 市場 39% 的營收份額，穩居龍頭寶座。
相較之下，儘管 SK 海力士第二季營收繳出年增 214% 的表現，但其市佔率卻從去年同期的 39% 驟降至 26%；而美光科技的市佔率則攀升至 25%，悄悄來到海力士身後，雙方差距僅剩 1 個百分點。
長約策略成「此消彼長」關鍵
分析指出，今年第二季傳統 DRAM 價格較上季顯著上漲，但高頻寬記憶體（HBM）價格則較去年同期走低。受現有 HBM3E 產品降價以及 HBM4 量產延遲影響，HBM 平均售價降幅較為明顯。
隨著傳統 DRAM 持續走揚，目前相對較低的 HBM 價格預計將在 2027 年迎來大幅上漲，這也成為三星與 SK 海力士此消彼長的核心原因。
Counterpoint 研究總監 MS Hwang 分析說明，SK 海力士的出貨量與營收中，HBM 的佔比為競爭對手中最高，因此在 HBM 價格下跌時受到的衝擊較大。
此外，海力士較競爭對手更早簽署長期協議（LTA），在記憶體價格上漲的週期中，也間接影響了營收的彈性空間。
不過，對海力士而言，隨著輝達與 AMD 新一代旗艦 AI 機架開始出貨，帶動 HBM4 出貨量增加，仍具備潛在利多支撐。
儘管如此，Counterpoint 仍預期美光科技憑藉強勁的成長動能，有機會超越 SK 海力士，躍居全球 DRAM 第二大廠商。
研究副總裁尼爾 · 沙阿（Neil Shah）指出：「美光的 DRAM 營收自 2025 年第二季度以來已成長 5 倍。這最終將取決於誰擁有足夠產能，避免將利潤拱手讓給競爭對手，以及長期供應協議如何形成。」
長鑫科技高速崛起 劍指全球三強
在三大巨頭激烈廝殺的同時，中國 DRAM 龍頭長鑫科技以高達 716% 的年增率，成為全球成長最快的 DRAM 供應商，引發市場高度關注。
沙阿認為，如果長鑫能夠順利擴大產能、提升技術能力，並成功從 PC 市場及海外一線客戶切入，其市場份額將可望快速提升。
隨著長鑫的崛起，市場焦點已從「長鑫能否進入全球記憶體三強」轉變為「長鑫何時能夠躋身這一陣營」，儲存產業的競爭格局預計在一年後將發生顯著變化。
paras_en: Counterpoint Research's latest "Global Storage Tracker" report says the global DRAM market landscape is reshuffling rapidly. Samsung Electronics (005930KS) saw its Q2 market share climb again, returning to its highest level since 2024, while SK Hynix (000660KS) fell in share and now faces fierce competition from fast‑gaining Micron Technology (MU-US). Meanwhile, China’s DRAM maker ChangXin Technology (688825-CN) is growing quickly, adding a new variable to the worldwide memory industry.
The report shows Samsung Electronics captured 39% of global DRAM revenue in the second quarter of this year, solidifying its position at the top.

In contrast, although SK Hynix posted a 214% year‑over‑year revenue increase in Q2, its market share dropped sharply from 39% a year ago to 26%; Micron’s share rose to 25%, slipping just behind Hynix with only a one‑percentage‑point gap.
Long‑term strategy becomes a key "one gains, the other loses" factor.

The analysis notes that traditional DRAM prices rose markedly in Q2 versus the previous quarter, while high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) prices fell compared with the same period last year. The decline is driven by price cuts for existing HBM3E products and delays in HBM4 volume production, leading to a noticeable drop in average HBM selling prices.
As traditional DRAM continues to climb, the relatively low HBM price is expected to surge dramatically by 2027, which underpins the divergent fortunes of Samsung and SK Hynix.

Counterpoint research director MS Hwang explains that HBM accounts for the highest share of SK Hynix’s shipments and revenue among rivals, so the company feels the impact of falling HBM prices most strongly.
Furthermore, Hynix signed long‑term agreements (LTAs) earlier than its competitors, which also limits its revenue flexibility during periods of rising memory prices.
Nevertheless, with Nvidia and AMD rolling out new‑generation flagship AI servers, HBM4 shipments are set to increase, providing a potential upside for Hynix.
Despite this, Counterpoint still expects Micron, powered by strong growth momentum, to overtake SK Hynix and become the world’s second‑largest DRAM supplier.

Research vice‑president Neil Shah said, "Micron’s DRAM revenue has grown five‑fold since Q2 2025. The ultimate outcome will depend on who can secure enough capacity, avoid handing profits to rivals, and how long‑term supply agreements are shaped."
ChangXin Technology’s rapid rise targets the global top three.

While the three giants battle intensely, China’s DRAM leader ChangXin Technology posted a staggering 716% year‑over‑year growth rate, making it the fastest‑growing DRAM supplier worldwide and drawing strong market attention.
Shah believes that if ChangXin can successfully expand capacity, improve technology, and break into the PC market and top overseas customers, its market share could rise quickly.

As ChangXin ascends, the focus shifts from "whether ChangXin can join the global memory top three" to "when ChangXin will enter that elite group," and the storage industry’s competitive landscape is expected to change markedly within a year.

items.title: 全球第二大矽晶圓廠SUMCO(3436-JP)陷折舊高峰 新廠投產拖累前三季虧損擴大
items.title_en: SUMCO, World's Second-Largest Silicon Wafer Manufacturer, Faces Depreciation Peak
paras: 2026年08月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球排名第二大的日本矽晶圓大廠SUMCO(3436-JP)周四公布最新財測，預估2026年前三季（1至9月）合併淨損將擴大至128億日圓，高於去年同期淨損9.95億日圓，主因是佐賀縣新建先進半導體矽晶圓工廠投產後，折舊費用大幅增加。
公司預估，前三季營收將年增9%至3,330億日圓，但營業利益將由去年同期獲利58億日圓轉為虧損63億日圓。折舊費用預計增加198億日圓，達998億日圓，成為侵蝕獲利的主要因素。
從更長期的折舊趨勢來看，2026年將是SUMCO獲利承受折舊壓力最沉重的一年。根據市場最新預測，2026財年折舊費用將升至約1,380億日圓，創近年新高，主因是佐賀縣新建12吋矽晶圓廠陸續投產，使折舊成本集中認列。
儘管日圓走貶可望帶來約105億日圓的營業利益挹注，但仍不足以抵銷新廠折舊增加帶來的成本壓力。
SUMCO同日公布2026年上半年（1至6月）財報，營收2,150億日圓，較去年同期成長5%；淨損128億日圓，去年同期則為淨利30億日圓，顯示新產能投入初期對獲利造成明顯壓力。
值得注意的是，SUMCO目前仍未公布2026會計年度（截至2026年12月底）的全年財測。公司維持過去做法，每季財報僅提供下一季的業績展望，反映半導體產業景氣與矽晶圓需求仍存在較高不確定性。
公司在5月法說會指出，AI需求已從先進邏輯晶片擴大至高頻寬記憶體（HBM），近期AI伺服器SSD需求成長也開始帶動NAND市場，使12吋矽晶圓需求維持強勁，並預期相關需求將延續至2026年下半年及2027年初。

paras_en: On August 6, 2026, SUMCO (3436-JP), the world's second-largest silicon wafer manufacturer, announced its latest financial forecast, estimating that its consolidated net loss for the first three quarters (January to September) of 2026 will expand to 12.8 billion yen, higher than the net loss of 995 million yen in the same period last year, mainly due to the significant increase in depreciation costs after the production of its new advanced semiconductor silicon wafer factory in Saga Prefecture.

The company expects its revenue for the first three quarters to increase by 9% year-over-year to 333 billion yen, but its operating profit will turn into a loss of 6.3 billion yen from a profit of 5.8 billion yen in the same period last year. The depreciation cost is expected to increase by 19.8 billion yen to 99.8 billion yen, becoming the main factor eroding profits.

From a longer-term perspective, 2026 will be the year when SUMCO's profits will be most heavily affected by depreciation pressure. According to the latest market forecast, the depreciation cost for the 2026 fiscal year will rise to approximately 138 billion yen, a new high in recent years, mainly due to the gradual production of the new 12-inch silicon wafer factory in Saga Prefecture, which will concentrate depreciation costs.

Although the depreciation of the yen is expected to bring in about 10.5 billion yen in operating profit, it will not be enough to offset the cost pressure caused by the increase in depreciation of the new factory.

On the same day, SUMCO announced its financial report for the first half of 2026 (January to June), with revenue of 215 billion yen, up 5% from the same period last year, and a net loss of 12.8 billion yen, compared to a net profit of 3 billion yen in the same period last year, showing that the initial investment in new production capacity has put significant pressure on profits.

It is worth noting that SUMCO has not yet announced its full-year financial forecast for the 2026 fiscal year (ending December 2026). The company maintains its past practice of only providing a forecast for the next quarter in its quarterly financial reports, reflecting the high uncertainty in the semiconductor industry and silicon wafer demand.

In its May earnings conference, the company pointed out that AI demand has expanded from advanced logic chips to high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and recently, the growth in AI server SSD demand has also driven the NAND market, making 12-inch silicon wafer demand strong, and it is expected that this demand will continue until the second half of 2026 and the first half of 2027.

items.title: 川普稱與伊朗協議進展順利 堅決否認彈藥短缺傳聞
items.title_en: Trump Claims Progress in Iran Talks, Denies Shortage of Ammunition
paras: 面對已進入第七個月的美國—以色列對伊朗戰爭，美國總統川普周三 (5 日) 在拉斯維加斯的造勢活動中發表最新立場。川普重申，美國原本已準備好在上周末對伊朗發動「自第二次世界大戰以來最大規模的攻擊」，但在伊朗及其他中東國家的請求下，他決定叫停行動並啟動新一輪談判。
川普強調，雖然美軍正給予伊朗沉重打擊，但他更傾向於達成協議，因為他「不想殺人」。
川普指出，針對伊朗的談判將分兩個階段進行：第一階段聚焦於重新開放荷姆茲海峽，目標是使其恢復完全開放；第二階段則是實現伊朗的去核化。他向媒體表示，相關談判進展順利，最快可能在周三或周四發布正式公告。
目前伊朗正與阿曼探討共同管理海峽的航線協議，儘管伊朗官方對外宣稱僅透過阿曼調解，且要求美國必須先結束海軍封鎖，否則無法保證航行安全。
針對近期媒體報導美軍面臨嚴重彈藥缺口的說法，川普展現了極為強硬的否認立場。先前有報導引述知情人士消息指出，美國在對伊朗戰爭期間已耗盡幾乎所有全球庫存的長程精準飛彈 (如 ATACMS 和精準打擊飛彈)，且防禦性攔截飛彈的消耗速度已超過工業產能所能負擔。
川普周三晚間在社群媒體上對此強烈反擊，聲稱美國擁有「大量的彈藥」，且更多的彈藥正在製造中。他抨擊這些關於軍備不足的報導是「叛國言論」，並宣稱正在追捕這些洩密者，將對其尋求長期監禁的刑期。
國防部發言人也配合此立場，發表聲明強調美軍擁有執行任務所需的一切資源，並備有深厚的軍械庫以保護國家利益。
國防部長海格塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 先前也曾公開駁斥彈藥短缺的說法，稱其為媒體編造的故事，並強調美軍的庫存非常充裕且持續增強中。
在談判進行的同時，局勢依然緊繃。據報美國至少 12 個州的供水系統遭到可能與伊朗支持的駭客有關的網路攻擊。
此外，伊朗支持的葉門胡塞武裝 (青年運動) 組織持續在紅海與亞丁灣襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯油輪，試圖實施海上封鎖。
paras_en: US President Trump delivered his latest stance on the Iran-US-Israel war, which has entered its seventh month, during a campaign event in Las Vegas on Wednesday (5th). Trump reiterated that the US was ready to launch the 'largest attack since World War II' against Iran last weekend, but decided to call off the operation and start a new round of talks after requests from Iran and other Middle Eastern countries.
Trump emphasized that although the US military is giving Iran a heavy blow, he is more inclined to reach an agreement because he 'does not want to kill people'.

Trump pointed out that the talks with Iran will be divided into two stages: the first stage will focus on reopening the Strait of Hormuz, aiming to restore it to full openness; the second stage will achieve Iran's nuclear disarmament. He told the media that the relevant talks are progressing smoothly and may announce a formal announcement as early as Wednesday or Thursday.

Currently, Iran is discussing a joint management agreement for the shipping route with Oman, although the Iranian government claims that it will only be mediated through Oman and requires the US to lift the naval blockade first, otherwise it cannot guarantee safe navigation.

In response to recent media reports that the US military is facing a severe shortage of ammunition, Trump presented a very hardline denial stance. Earlier reports cited sources claiming that the US had exhausted almost all global stockpiles of long-range precision missiles (such as ATACMS and precision-guided missiles) during the war against Iran, and that the consumption rate of defensive intercept missiles had exceeded the industrial production capacity.

Trump strongly counterattacked on social media on Wednesday evening, claiming that the US has 'a lot of ammunition' and that more ammunition is being manufactured. He criticized these reports of military shortages as 'treasonous statements' and claimed that he is pursuing the leakers and will seek long-term imprisonment for them.

The Defense Department spokesperson also supported this stance, releasing a statement emphasizing that the US military has all the resources needed to carry out its tasks and has a deep arsenal to protect national interests.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth had previously publicly refuted the claims of ammunition shortages, calling them a media-fabricated story and emphasizing that the US military's stockpiles are very abundant and continuously increasing.
At the same time, the situation remains tense. According to reports, at least 12 US states' water supply systems have been attacked by hackers possibly linked to Iran.
In addition, the Houthi organization (Ansar Allah) supported by Iran continues to attack Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, attempting to implement a naval blockade.

items.title: 減重藥燒錢企業也買單 美銀一年砸2.5億美元挺員工用GLP-1
items.title_en: US Bank Spends $250 Million a Year on Employee GLP-1 Weight Loss Medication
paras: 以應酬文化盛行著稱的銀行業，意外成為減肥藥 GLP-1 的重要買單者。美國銀行 (BAC-US) 執行長布萊恩 · 莫伊尼漢（Brian Moynihan）透露，該行目前每年為員工負擔高達 2.5 億美元的 GLP-1 減重藥物費用。儘管支出快速攀升，他仍認為這項投資「物有所值」。
莫伊尼漢在談及相關成本時表示，該行在 GLP-1 藥物上的支出大約為 2.5 億美元或更多，而在四、五年前這個數字還是零。
據悉，美國銀行每年為約 21.1 萬名員工的醫療支出預留超過 20 億美元，這意味著 GLP-1 藥物目前已經佔據這筆預算的 13% 左右。
這番表態恰逢全球兩大 GLP-1 藥物生產商更新業績之際，其中諾和諾德與禮來 (LLY-US) 皆公布了最新的市場預期，顯示出這類藥物在全球範圍內的強勁需求與龐大商業規模。
在藥廠獲利豐厚的同時，全美各地的雇主都在應對 GLP-1 藥物引發的成本激增壓力。
對美國市場而言，一名患者用藥一年的成本可能高達數千美元。許多採用自保醫療模式的大企業和政府雇主發現，隨著 GLP-1 減肥藥的使用量快速增長，醫療支出壓力明顯上升，因此紛紛開始限制報銷範圍，或者討論是否還能負擔這些昂貴的治療。
然而，美國銀行卻採取了截然不同的態度，認為這筆巨額支出相當值得。莫伊尼漢指出，美國銀行在提供這些藥物的同時，也配套提供健康指導服務，以幫助員工監測減重過程並調整生活方式。
除了長期的預防性健康管理之外，他還指出越來越多的臨床數據顯示，這類藥物可能帶來更短期的健康益處，包括降低心血管事件發生率。
他總結道，觀察員工在這些調整過程中的行為變化以及體重下降，是一件非常有趣的事情。
同時，這家全美第二大銀行也正在利用自身的規模優勢，積極與藥廠以及藥品福利管理機構展開談判，以爭取更低的藥品價格。
莫伊尼漢強調，他們正在向所有相關方施壓，努力把價格壓到盡可能低的水平，並堅信考慮到這些藥物帶來的長期健康收益以及可能帶來的短期健康改善，這是一項非常值得進行的投資。
paras_en: US Bank, known for its lavish corporate culture, has become a major buyer of the weight loss medication GLP-1. Bank CEO Brian Moynihan revealed that the bank currently spends up to $250 million a year on GLP-1 medication for its employees, despite the rapidly increasing cost.
Moynihan noted that the bank's spending on GLP-1 medication is approximately $250 million or more, up from zero just four or five years ago.
According to reports, US Bank allocates over $2 billion a year for its employees' medical expenses, which means GLP-1 medication currently accounts for around 13% of this budget.

This statement comes as the two major GLP-1 medication manufacturers, Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly, have recently updated their earnings, showing strong demand and a massive commercial scale for this type of medication globally.
While pharmaceutical companies are reaping huge profits, employers across the US are struggling to cope with the rising costs of GLP-1 medication.

For the US market, a patient's annual cost of using GLP-1 medication can be as high as several thousand dollars. Many large companies and government employers that have adopted self-insured medical plans have found that the rapid growth in GLP-1 medication usage has significantly increased their medical expenses, leading them to restrict coverage or discuss whether they can still afford these expensive treatments.

However, US Bank has taken a different approach, considering the massive expenditure worthwhile. Moynihan pointed out that the bank provides health guidance services alongside the medication to help employees monitor their weight loss progress and adjust their lifestyles.

In addition to long-term preventive health management, he noted that more and more clinical data show that these medications may bring short-term health benefits, including a reduced risk of cardiovascular events.
He concluded that observing employees' behavior changes and weight loss is a very interesting thing.
At the same time, the second-largest bank in the US is using its scale to actively negotiate with pharmaceutical companies and pharmacy benefit managers to secure lower prices for the medication.

Moynihan emphasized that they are putting pressure on all relevant parties to try to bring the price down as much as possible and believe that considering the long-term health benefits and possible short-term health improvements, this is a worthwhile investment.

items.title: SanDisk(SNDK-US)：2027年資料中心將占NAND市場一半 AI需求推升供不應求延續
items.title_en: SanDisk: AI Demand to Drive NAND Market to Half-Year Supply Shortage in 2027
paras: 2026年08月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心持續大量採購儲存設備，讓NAND Flash記憶體市場維持供不應求。SanDisk(SNDK-US)在最新法說會表示，目前客戶下單速度仍快於公司擴產速度，預期市場供給吃緊的情況將延續至2027年底之後，價格可望持續獲得支撐。
SanDisk指出，AI推論（Inference）快速普及，使資料中心需要安裝更多高容量SSD來儲存與讀取資料，每一次AI運算都會產生大量資料，帶動NAND Flash需求持續攀升。公司預估，2027年資料中心將占整體NAND市場約一半，成為最大的需求來源。
雖然AI需求持續成長，SanDisk並未採取大幅擴建晶圓廠的方式增加供給，而是調整產能擴張策略，將重點放在BiCS 8與BiCS 10等新製程轉換，透過提高單位晶圓可生產的儲存容量，讓bit供給維持中至高雙位數成長。例如，最新BiCS 10採用332層NAND架構，儲存密度超過29 Gb/mm²，較前一代提升59%。
儘管如此，管理層表示，目前需求成長仍快於供給，因此不少產品仍採取配貨（allocation）方式供應，也就是客戶即使想買更多，公司也沒有足夠產能立即供貨。
為了避免過去記憶體產業大起大落的景氣循環，SanDisk近幾季也改變銷售模式，不再只按季度接單，而是與大型AI資料中心客戶簽訂4至5年的長期供貨合約。目前已有8家大型客戶加入，2027財年超過50%的產能已提前售出，2028財年更有約三分之二產能已被預訂。
更值得注意的是，公司透露，部分客戶才剛簽完長約數個月，就再次增加未來3至5年的採購量，顯示AI基礎建設需求仍持續升溫，而非短期現象。
SanDisk執行長David Goeckeler表示，過去NAND市場多半每季重新議價，供需波動較大；如今公司已掌握超過4年的訂單能見度，能依據客戶長期需求安排投資與產能，有助於降低過去供過於求、價格暴跌的情況。
財報方面，SanDisk本季營收達98.65億美元，高於市場預估的83.95億美元；每股盈餘39.25美元，也優於市場預估的34.52美元。公司預估下一季營收將達103億至108億美元，高於市場預估的106.2億美元區間下緣。

paras_en: August 6, 2026 (Opt Analytics/Industry Data Center Report) - AI data centers continue to purchase storage equipment in large quantities, maintaining a shortage in the NAND Flash memory market. SanDisk (SNDK-US) stated in its latest earnings call that customer orders are still outpacing the company's production capacity, and the market supply shortage is expected to continue beyond the end of 2027, with prices likely to remain supported.

SanDisk pointed out that the rapid proliferation of AI inference has led to data centers needing to install more high-capacity SSDs to store and read data, with each AI computation generating a large amount of data, driving NAND Flash demand to continue rising. The company estimates that data centers will account for about half of the total NAND market in 2027, becoming the largest source of demand.

Although AI demand continues to grow, SanDisk has not taken a large-scale expansion of its wafer factory to increase supply, but rather adjusted its production capacity expansion strategy, focusing on new process conversions such as BiCS 8 and BiCS 10, through which the company aims to maintain high double-digit growth in bit supply by increasing the storage capacity of each wafer.
For example, the latest BiCS 10 uses a 332-layer NAND architecture, with a storage density of over 29 Gb/mm², a 59% increase over the previous generation.

Despite this, management stated that the current demand growth is still faster than supply, with many products being supplied through allocation, meaning that even if customers want to buy more, the company does not have enough production capacity to supply immediately.

To avoid the past memory industry's boom-and-bust cycle, SanDisk has changed its sales model in recent quarters, no longer only taking orders on a quarterly basis, but signing 4- to 5-year long-term supply contracts with large AI data center customers. Currently, 8 large customers have joined, with over 50% of production capacity already sold out for the 2027 fiscal year, and approximately two-thirds of production capacity already booked for the 2028 fiscal year.

Notably, the company revealed that some customers have increased their future purchases of 3- to 5-years within a few months of signing long-term contracts, indicating that AI infrastructure demand continues to heat up, rather than being a short-term phenomenon.

SanDisk CEO David Goeckeler stated that in the past, the NAND market was largely renegotiated every quarter, with supply and demand fluctuations being large; now, the company has visibility of over 4 years of orders, allowing it to arrange investments and production capacity based on long-term customer demand, which has helped to reduce the past over-supply and price crashes.

In terms of financials, SanDisk's quarterly revenue reached $9.865 billion, exceeding market estimates of $8.395 billion; earnings per share were $39.25, also exceeding market estimates of $34.52. The company estimates that next quarter's revenue will reach $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion, exceeding market estimates of $10.62 billion.

items.title: 富士軟片FujiFilm(4901-JP)啟動重大重組 擬分拆35%營收的富士全錄
items.title_en: FujiFilm (4901-JP) Initiates Major Restructuring, Plans to Spin Off 35% of Revenue from Fuji Xerox
paras: 2026年08月06日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本富士軟片控股FujiFilm Holdings(4901-JP)周四宣布，已開始評估分拆旗下辦公設備子公司FUJIFILM Business Innovation（前身為富士全錄Fuji Xerox，富士軟片收購美國Xerox持股後更名），計畫於未來2至3年內在東京證券交易所掛牌上市。
根據公司規畫，富士軟片控股將在分拆完成後，把持股比例降至略低於20%，使FUJIFILM Business Innovation成為獨立上市公司。
FUJIFILM Business Innovation主要從事辦公室多功能事務機相關業務，目前約占富士軟片控股整體營收35%，是集團重要的營運部門之一。
獨立之後，該公司將不再是富士軟片控股的主要子公司，可望擁有更大的經營自主權與獨立募資能力，而富士軟片控股則可將資源進一步集中於醫療、半導體材料及影像等成長性較高的核心事業。

paras_en: August 6, 2026 (Optimization Analysis / Industry Data Center Report) - FujiFilm Holdings (4901-JP) announced on Thursday that it has begun evaluating the spin-off of its office equipment subsidiary, FUJIFILM Business Innovation (formerly Fuji Xerox, renamed after FujiFilm acquired Xerox's stake), with plans to list it on the Tokyo Stock Exchange within the next 2-3 years.
According to the company's plan, FujiFilm Holdings will reduce its stake to slightly below 20% after the spin-off, making FUJIFILM Business Innovation an independent listed company.

FUJIFILM Business Innovation primarily engages in office multifunctional copier-related businesses, accounting for approximately 35% of FujiFilm Holdings' total revenue, making it an important operational department within the group.

After becoming independent, the company will no longer be FujiFilm Holdings' main subsidiary, and is expected to have greater operational autonomy and independent fundraising capabilities, while FujiFilm Holdings can further concentrate its resources on high-growth core businesses such as medical, semiconductor materials, and imaging.
